jobs.description:
💻We Are Hiring - Full Stack (Blazor / .NET 8) Developer | 100% Remote

We are looking to expand our team with a highly skilled Junior and Senior Full Stack Developer to support the development and continuous enhancement of an innovative game hosting SaaS platform. This project is designed to revolutionize game hosting, reduce server crowding, and integrate a sub-model centered around virtual machines.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with our in-house team to develop and maintain a Blazor-based web application, ensuring seamless integration, performance, and scalability. This position requires hands-on development, strong collaboration skills, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.

If you're passionate about cutting-edge technology and want to be part of a long-term partnership with a team that values the top 1% of developers, we'd love to hear from you!

As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for:

  • Developing, maintaining, and enhancing a Blazor-based web application using .NET 8.
  • Collaborating with internal team members to meet project milestones and integrate system components.
  • Designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.
  • Implementing front-end features using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Working with SQL databases for efficient data storage and retrieval.
  • Ensuring code quality, security, and performance throughout the application.
  • Participating in regular meetings using the client’s communications system (Azure).

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you need to have:

  • At least 5 years of experience using C# / .Net
  • Experience building API using .Net technologies
  • Experience using Blazor and MudBlazor
  • Experience with Entity Framework and SQL Server

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of SaaS or multi-tenant architecture
  • Hands-on experience with Azure services like repo, service bus, pipelines
  • Background in Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD B2C and OAuth 2.0 / OIDC flows.

As a Junior Full Stack Developer, you need to have:

  • 1–3 years of professional or substantial project experience in C# / .NET
  • Hands-on experience building web UIs — Blazor experience strongly preferred; strong Razor Pages or MVC experience with a clear desire to move to Blazor is acceptable
  • Solid understanding of front-end fundamentals: layout, component design, and user experience
  • Comfort reading and writing REST API calls and understanding request/response cycles
  • Familiarity with SQL and basic data access patterns (EF Core or similar ORM a plus)
  • Proficiency with Git and a feature-branch workflow

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MudBlazor or another Blazor component library
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure services (personal projects or coursework count)
  • Familiarity with Azure Pipelines or other CI/CD tooling
  • Interest in gaming, game servers, or online multiplayer infrastructure
  • Experience with structured logging or basic observability concepts

🕒 Working Hours: 11 PM to 8 AM Philippine Time

🚀 Engagement: Full-time engagement

💎 What You’ll Get

  • Above-market compensation.
  • Long-term opportunity.
  • Opportunity to shape user-facing experiences that reach thousands of users.
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented work culture.
  • Enjoy a Signing Bonus of PHP 50,000 upon joining!

🚨 Don’t Meet Every Requirement?

No worries. If you're a strong developer and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply! We’re always looking for exceptional people—even if they don’t check every box.

💬 Referral Program – Earn While You Help!

Know someone who’s a great fit for this role?

Refer a candidate and earn up to ₱20,000 per successful hire. There’s no limit—refer as many qualified developers as you like!

jobs.description:
Permanent position with the possibility to work remotely.

Are you passionate about transforming complex spatial biology data into actionable insights? Do you thrive in a cross-functional environment bridging experimental and computational teams? Moleculent is looking for an experienced Computational Biology Senior Scientist with Immunology knowledge to drive and evolve our Applications and Fee-for-Service (FFS) initiatives. Join us to contribute to cutting-edge technology that unveils new perspectives on human biology!

Moleculent is on an exciting mission to map cell communication at the molecular level in tissue, aiming to unlock radical new insights into human biology. This is a chance to join a focused and dedicated team with extensive experience in building successful life science companies and products.

We welcome your application today. We are interviewing candidates continuously.

JOB DESCRIPTION

As a Senior Computational Biology Scientist, you will play a key role in driving data analysis workflows for customer and internal validation projects. You will take ownership of project design, biological interpretation, and stakeholder communication, working closely with wet-lab scientists, the Applications Team Lead, and R&D to ensure high-quality, reliable data insights.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and interpret analysis strategies to support application development and pilot studies.

  • Execute image preprocessing, cell segmentation, and spatial metrics extraction using established pipelines.

  • Compile and visualize results into standardized reports for internal use and customer delivery.

  • Collaborate on refining methods, troubleshooting, and prototyping new analysis metrics.

  • Ensure data traceability and compliance with Moleculent's data packaging standards.

QUALIFICATIONS

To fit this role well, you should hold an MSc or PhD in computational biology, bioinformatics, image analysis, spatial omics, or a related field. It’s a strong advantage if you have completed a postdoc in a relevant field. Fluency in both written and spoken English, along with strong computer skills, is essential. Experience in clearly and effectively presenting data—both in writing and in oral presentations—is a key requirement.

  • Proficiency in Python and spatial single-cell analysis, with the ability to design, execute, and interpret analysis workflows for complex datasets.

  • A solid understanding of immunology is important, as our data closely relates to immune cell populations, marker panels, and tissue-based immune profiling.

  • Experience working directly with customers—whether through pilot studies, fee-for-service delivery, or technical support—is highly valued in this role.

  • Experience working across R&D, product, and commercial functions is a plus.

  • Skilled in summarizing insights for cross-functional teams.

MOLECULENT

We believe that our understanding of the molecular basis of human biology, in health and disease will increase radically in the coming ten years. This will lead to a vast improvement in therapies, and diagnostics, and a new, fundamental understanding of our own biology.

Moleculent is on a mission to develop technology-enabled products that leverage new insights into the molecular foundation of human biology.

jobs.excerpt: About Concept Plus Concept Plus is a mission-focused technology solutions provider that transforms IT concepts into impactful solutions for federal agencies.
jobs.description:
About Concept Plus

Concept Plus is a mission-focused technology solutions provider that transforms IT concepts into impactful solutions for federal agencies. Headquartered in Fairfax, VA, we bring the agility, responsiveness, and customer intimacy of a small business combined with the quality and infrastructure of a larger firm.

Recognized as an award-winning Oracle partner, we have delivered innovative solutions across Defense, Intelligence, Civilian, Health IT, and Tribal sectors. Our highly certified experts build systems that drive efficiency, accelerate modernization, and ensure mission outcomes with certainty.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.

For more information, visit .

About the role

Concept Plus is seeking an experienced Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Engineer to support the transition of a mission-critical Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) environment from on-premises infrastructure to Oracle Cloud Exadata Infrastructure. This role will focus on architecting, deploying, and optimizing OCI resources required for EBS, ensuring the solution meets stringent government security, availability, and performance requirements. A key responsibility will be designing and implementing cross-region disaster recovery (DR) for EBS within OCI to ensure continuity of operations (COOP) and mission resilience.

What you'll do

  • E-Business Suite Cloud Migration
    • Lead the end-to-end migration of a mission-critical EBS environment from on-premises to OCI, including planning, architecture, deployment, data migration, and cutover support.
    • Assess current on-prem environments and design target OCI architectures that align with performance, availability, security, and government compliance requirements.
    • Architect and configure OCI components required for EBS: Compute, Block Storage, Object Storage, VCN, Load Balancing, File Storage, Database services, and identity/security services.
    • Coordinate with DBA, application, and network teams to ensure successful migration of application tiers, database tiers, and custom EBS integrations.
  • Cross-Region Disaster Recovery for E-Business Suite
    • Design, build, and validate a cross-region DR architecture for EBS using OCI services such as block volume replication, database Data Guard, object storage replication, and load balancer failover strategies.
    • Implement automated replication, failover, and recovery procedures for both the EBS application tier and database tier.
    • Develop COOP/DR runbooks, testing plans, and failover/failback procedures tailored to mission-critical government workloads.
    • Lead periodic DR tests and ATO-aligned validation exercises to ensure readiness for region-wide outages.
  • Cloud Architecture, Security & Compliance
    • Ensure all EBS migration and DR activities adhere to federal standards including FedRAMP, FISMA, and NIST 800-53 security controls.
    • Configure IAM policies, compartments, network security groups, WAF, encryption (KMS), and audit logging to meet government governance requirements.
    • Support security assessments, SSP updates, ATO processes, and POA&M resolution activities for cloud-hosted EBS systems.
  • Operational Support & Optimization
    • Monitor OCI infrastructure supporting EBS workloads for performance, cost, and reliability; implement tuning and scaling strategies as needed.
    • Develop and implement patching strategies for EBS components hosted in OCI, including coordination across environments (DEV/TEST/STAGE/PROD).
    • Troubleshoot EBS-related cloud issues including performance bottlenecks, networking, replication issues, or cross-region failover behavior.
  • Automation & Infrastructure as Code
    • Create and maintain Terraform or OCI Resource Manager IaC templates for provisioning EBS-related OCI infrastructure.
    • Automate environment builds, DR replication processes, and deployment pipelines to support EBS lifecycle operations.
    • Integrate compliance, configuration, and security automation into cloud operations wherever possible.
  • Collaboration & Government Mission Support
    • Work closely with program managers, DBAs, application SMEs, security teams, and network engineers to ensure the migration and DR solutions meet mission-critical requirements.
    • Prepare architecture diagrams, migration plans, DR test results, and documentation required for government technical review boards and audits.
    • Provide engineering expertise and technical leadership throughout the migration lifecycle and ongoing multi-region operations.

Qualifications

  • US Citizen with an active Secret Clearance.
  • 3–7+ years of experience in cloud engineering with at least 2 years focused on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Experience working in government IT environments or highly regulated sectors.
  • Strong understanding of NIST security controls, zero-trust principles, and cloud governance.
  • Proficiency with Terraform and scripting languages (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).
  • Experience with cloud networking concepts including VCNs, DRGs, VPN, FastConnect, and firewalls.
  • Experience with implementation of Oracle Exadata computing system.
  • Familiarity with Oracle databases and government-hosted Oracle workloads (e.g., Exadata Cloud Service).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to collaborate within cross-functional and global teams
  • Ability to prioritize and multitask in high-pressure environments
  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate or Professional certification preferred.
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP High or DoD IL4/IL5 cloud environments preferred.
  • Experience with container technologies (Kubernetes, OKE, Docker) in secure environments preferred.
  • Knowledge of government logging, monitoring, and SIEM tools (Splunk, Elastic, Oracle Logging/Monitoring) preferred.

Concept Plus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As such, we will give your application full consideration without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

Job Overview:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Estimator to support the preconstruction and estimating operations of a U.S.-based commercial construction company.

This is a senior-level construction estimating role focused primarily on full-cycle estimating, while also contributing to trade partner development and AI-enabled process improvement. The successful candidate will take ownership of estimating work from bid intake and document review through quantity takeoffs, pricing, subcontractor solicitation, bid leveling, estimate assembly, and internal review.

The ideal candidate is a construction professional with strong estimating judgment, mathematical accuracy, excellent attention to detail, and the confidence to communicate directly with U.S.-based subcontractors and trade partners.

Job Details:

  • Work set up: Work from Home
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Central Time | 9:00 PM-6:00 AM Manila Time
  • Holiday: Will follow US holiday calendar

Responsibilities:

Estimating & Preconstruction – 70%

  • Manage assigned projects through the full-cycle estimating process, from bid intake through internal review and handoff.
  • Review invitations to bid, drawings, specifications, addenda, bid forms, schedules, alternates, allowances, and submission requirements.
  • Maintain organized bid documentation, including bid calendars, document registers, addenda logs, and estimate status trackers.
  • Read and interpret architectural, structural, civil, MEP, specialty, and vendor documents and translate project requirements into scopes, quantities, and cost components.
  • Identify scope gaps, drawing conflicts, missing information, constructability concerns, long-lead items, and other project risks.
  • Perform detailed and auditable quantity takeoffs using consistent measurement methods, plan references, units, assemblies, waste factors, and revision controls.
  • Develop labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, general conditions, permits, freight, taxes, escalation, allowances, and contingency components as applicable.
  • Prepare trade-specific scopes and solicit competitive bids from qualified subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Analyze and level subcontractor proposals by reviewing inclusions, exclusions, qualifications, alternates, unit rates, schedules, lead times, and commercial risks.
  • Prepare clear assumptions, clarifications, exclusions, RFIs, and risk items for management review.
  • Develop a clear Basis of Estimate documenting the project basis, scope, methodology, pricing, quotes, assumptions, allowances, exclusions, and risks.
  • Reconcile quantities, formulas, units, extensions, markups, and estimate totals and perform thorough quality checks before review.
  • Support conceptual, schematic, budget, negotiated, hard-bid, change-order, and value-engineering estimates as applicable.
  • Prepare estimates for internal review and clearly communicate the cost rationale, assumptions, and outstanding risks.
  • Support the conversion of awarded estimates into useful turnover information for project execution and procurement.
  • Capture bid results and estimate-to-actual feedback to improve future estimating accuracy.

Trade Partner Development – 20%

  • Build and maintain a strong network of qualified subcontractors and suppliers across relevant markets.
  • Identify potential trade partners based on trade specialty, geography, project type, capacity, and project requirements.
  • Conduct professional outbound calls and email outreach to U.S.-based subcontractors and suppliers.
  • Introduce qualified trade partners to bidding opportunities and maintain ongoing professional relationships.
  • Learn each trade partner's capabilities, service areas, capacity, and project preferences.
  • Prepare targeted invitations to bid rather than relying on mass outreach.
  • Maintain accurate relationship records, including contact history, bidding participation, quote quality, and follow-up actions.
  • Support the qualification process by gathering relevant company, licensing, insurance, safety, capacity, and project experience information.
  • Help re-engage inactive or high-potential trade partners.
  • Monitor trade partner participation, responsiveness, reliability, and overall performance.

AI & Process Improvement – 10%

  • Identify opportunities to improve estimating efficiency, accuracy, and consistency through AI, automation, data, and workflow improvements.
  • Explore practical applications of AI for document review, addenda comparison, RFI drafting, proposal analysis, data organization, and repetitive estimating tasks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve subcontractor sourcing, follow-ups, relationship management, and bid coverage through technology.
  • Support the development of repeatable workflows, checklists, SOPs, templates, and reporting tools.
  • Test proposed improvements against known results and maintain appropriate human review and quality controls.
  • Ensure AI-assisted outputs are verified against source documents and do not replace professional estimating judgment.
  • Document successful process improvements so they can be consistently adopted by the broader team.

Qualifications:

Required

  • At least 5 years of experience in construction estimating, quantity surveying, or preconstruction.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based construction projects or projects with comparable construction standards and estimating practices.
  • Strong full-cycle estimating experience, beyond quantity takeoff, including bid planning, scope development, subcontractor solicitation, quote analysis, bid leveling, estimate documentation, internal review, and handoff.
  • Ability to confidently read and interpret architectural, structural, civil, MEP, and specialty construction documents.
  • Strong mathematical and analytical reasoning skills, including dimensions, conversions, production rates, labor assumptions, waste, freight, taxes, escalation, markups, and reconciliation.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to work with structured tables, formulas, lookups, pivot tables, validation, and error checks.
  • Strong document control and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Comfortable making outbound calls to U.S.-based subcontractors and trade partners, asking scope-related questions, following up on bids, and building professional relationships.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple estimates, deadlines, and follow-ups.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining clear communication and escalating issues early.
  • Reliable internet connection, backup connectivity/power, and a professional remote work environment.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have:

  • 5+ years of construction estimating or preconstruction experience.
  • Experience with commercial construction, particularly commercial buildouts.
  • Experience across multiple construction sectors such as residential remodeling, civil/site work, structural steel or fabrication, or pre-engineered metal buildings.
  • Knowledge of CSI MasterFormat.
  • Experience with conceptual and detailed estimating, design-build preconstruction, value engineering, procurement strategy, or estimate-to-actual analysis.
  • Experience developing or managing a subcontractor sourcing, qualification, CRM, bid participation, or performance management program.
  • Experience with takeoff and construction platforms such as Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, STACK, On-Screen Takeoff, Procore, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with construction management, ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Exposure to AI tools, automation, workflow orchestration, Power Automate, Make, Zapier, n8n, Python, APIs, Power BI, or similar technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI or automation to improve a real business workflow is a strong advantage.
  • Degree or formal training in construction management, civil engineering, architecture, quantity surveying, cost engineering, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Professional training or certification through organizations such as ASPE, AACE, or RICS is a plus.

jobs.description:
Family Office Investment Services Manager

About the Role

FSM seeks a CFA Charterholder to lead investment services delivery — and directly manage capital — across a growing roster of ultra-high-net-worth client families. This role carries a dual mandate: you are both the institutional framework builder who ensures every advisor is tracked, benchmarked, and held accountable, and a discretionary portfolio manager with direct responsibility for assigned capital sleeves within each client's overall allocation.

This is a rare seat for a CFA who has managed real money, is fluent in multi-asset portfolio construction, and can simultaneously operate at the orchestration level — sitting above a roster of outside managers — and at the execution level, managing positions directly. You will not be a passive scorekeeper. You will be in the game.

What You'll Own

Discretionary Portfolio Management

  • Manage assigned capital sleeves across client portfolios on a fully discretionary basis, spanning liquid equities, fixed income, and select alternatives
  • Construct and maintain model portfolios with explicit factor exposures, benchmark targets, and risk budgets approved by the client principal
  • Execute investment decisions including security selection, position sizing, rebalancing, and tactical allocation shifts within the agreed investment policy statement (IPS)
  • Generate time-weighted and money-weighted return reporting on directly managed sleeves, held to the same S&P 500 benchmark standard applied to all outside managers
  • Produce written investment rationale for every material position change — no undocumented trades
  • Coordinate with client tax advisors on tax-lot management, wash sale rules, and the interaction between active trading and the client's broader tax posture

Investment Oversight & Multi-Manager Coordination

  • Maintain and continuously improve performance measurement frameworks for each client's full advisor roster, benchmarked against the S&P 500 and appropriate secondary indices
  • Produce quarterly manager scorecards covering rolling 1-, 3-, and 5-year returns (gross and net of fees), with plain-English summaries written for principals, not advisors
  • Build and maintain pairwise correlation matrices and factor-decomposed diversification analyses across all active managers, including directly managed sleeves
  • Perform look-through concentration analysis to surface true single-name, sector, geography, and thematic exposures across the entire portfolio — including positions you hold directly

Portfolio Analytics & Risk

  • Decompose each manager's results by asset class, sector, and factor exposure (value, growth, size, momentum); apply the same attribution framework to your own directly managed sleeves
  • Develop and maintain liquidity waterfall models under defined stress scenarios, incorporating LP lockups, directly held positions, real estate assumptions, and credit line availability
  • Monitor concentration risk in real time across all sleeves — both managed externally and managed directly — and escalate when aggregate exposures exceed agreed thresholds
  • Partner with the FSM operations team on cross-entity insurance and risk audits, contributing investment-side risk context

Investment Policy & Client Governance

  • Draft and maintain a written Investment Policy Statement (IPS) for each client, covering return objectives, risk tolerance, liquidity requirements, constraints, and benchmark selection
  • Lead quarterly investment review meetings with family principals; present performance of directly managed sleeves alongside outside manager scorecards in a unified format
  • Participate in asset allocation reviews with the client's strategic advisor; provide quantitative support for allocation shift recommendations
  • Translate institutional-grade analytics into direct, no-jargon deliverables that respect client sophistication without burying them in unnecessary complexity

Advisor Coordination & Governance

  • Serve as FSM's primary point of contact for each client's wealth management roster, operating as an objective oversight layer above individual outside managers
  • Facilitate quarterly advisor review sessions; provide written scorecard summaries to the client principal in advance of each meeting
  • Coordinate on capital call timing, distribution reinvestment, and cash management across all sleeves

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • CFA Charterholder in good standing
  • Series 65 (or Series 66) license, or willingness to obtain prior to assuming discretionary management responsibilities; RIA registration experience preferred
  • 7+ years of experience in investment management, with demonstrated responsibility for managing discretionary capital — not just analyzing or recommending
  • Deep fluency in portfolio construction, performance attribution, factor analysis, and multi-asset risk management
  • Direct experience with investment policy statements, rebalancing frameworks, and client-level reporting for discretionary accounts
  • Demonstrated experience working in or alongside multi-entity family office structures (trusts, LLCs, LP structures, multi-state tax exposure)
  • Proficiency with portfolio management and analytics tools (Addepar, Black Diamond, Orion, Masttro, or equivalents); ability to operate effectively without them when necessary
  • Exceptional written communication — your investment memos and scorecards will go directly to principals

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a named portfolio manager on a discretionary account with documented performance track record
  • Experience managing capital in a family office or multi-family office environment, not just an institutional or retail wealth context
  • Familiarity with crypto asset reporting, covered call overlays on concentrated positions, and the tax coordination those strategies require
  • Working knowledge of LP/PE structures, capital call mechanics, and IRR computation for illiquid sleeves
  • Comfort operating without a large support infrastructure — this role rewards self-sufficiency and judgment under ambiguity

What FSM Is Not Looking For

  • Analysts who have recommended trades but never owned the P&L
  • Advisors whose primary value proposition is tax optimization over investment returns
  • Portfolio managers who manage to a style box rather than to a client's actual objectives
  • Candidates who equate glossy client materials with institutional rigor

Who You'll Work With

You will report to FSM's engagement lead and work alongside the FSM operations team, client tax advisors, outside wealth managers, legal counsel, and the family principals themselves. Clients are performance-first, intellectually rigorous, and allergic to theater. You will be held to the same benchmark standard you apply to every outside manager on the roster — and that's exactly the point.

Compensation

Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, performance-based bonus tied to portfolio outcomes, client retention, and deliverable quality, and equity participation in FSM's family office practice as it scales. AUM-based compensation is not the primary structure — by design — though performance incentives tied to risk-adjusted returns on directly managed sleeves are on the table for the right candidate.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, SEO & GEO
jobs.excerpt: Senior Manager, SEO & GEOSearch Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels Push the boundaries of discovery.
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Appropriate accommodations will be provided upon request as required by applicable law and company policy. Any information received relating to accommodations will be treated as confidential.

jobs.description:
Copilot Developer/AI Engineer - Entry-Level

Hands-on development and technical architecture for Copilot agents, automations, and integrations

Role Overview

The entry-level Copilot Developer/AI Engineer turns strategic blueprints into working agents, workflows, and integrations, while also providing architectural guidance for complex implementations. They develop Copilot agents, Power Automate flows, reusable prompt “skills,” and locally-run AI solutions using tools such as Claude, ensure solutions are scalable and secure, and support the team through technical standards, mentorship, and escalation handling. A strong working knowledge of modern AI tools — particularly Microsoft Copilot and Claude (and related tools) — is central to the role, as is the curiosity to continually seek out and evaluate new AI platforms while operating responsibly within a regulated environment with strict data controls.

Description

We are seeking a Microsoft Power Platform Developer who is also familiar with Microsoft Copilot Studio to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, implement, and optimize AI-powered productivity and automation solutions for a diverse portfolio of clients.

You will partner closely within an internal team to identify opportunities where the Power Platform, Power Automate, and Microsoft Copilot Studio — as well as other AI tools and technologies, including Claude used locally outside of the Microsoft 365 environment — can deliver transformative business value, ensuring that solutions are strategically aligned, technically sound, and effectively adopted. Engagements allow you to take ownership from solution development through implementation, optimization, and adoption. Throughout, you will work within a regulated environment governed by strict data controls, balancing rapid AI experimentation with rigorous compliance and data protection.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Architecture & Development

Develop application in PowerApps using Dataverse, Power Automate, Excel, Forms and SharePoint online. Use multiple Out-of-The-Box connectors with Power Apps, Power Automate. Develop and deploy Microsoft Copilot Studio solutions that integrate seamlessly with Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Platform (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps), and other enterprise systems. Build and run AI-assisted solutions using Claude locally — outside of the Microsoft 365 environment — for development, prototyping, and automation, while keeping data handling compliant with organizational and client controls. Incorporate adaptive cards, variables, triggers, connectors, and API integrations into Copilot Studio solutions to maximize functionality.

Collaborate in prompt engineering: crafting effective prompts, skills, and grounding/context strategies across both Copilot and Claude (and related tools). Participate in solution testing, validation, and quality assurance Technical feasibility analysis, solution design documentation, and user guides Ensure solutions comply with Microsoft security, compliance, and governance standards, including Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Purview, and DLP (Data Loss Prevention) policies. Apply strict data-control practices to all AI tooling — including locally-run models such as Claude — ensuring sensitive and regulated data is handled, stored, and transmitted in accordance with policy. Mentor teammates, provide technical guidance, and handle escalated issues from deployed solutions

Optimization & Continuous Improvement

Develop supporting documentation, user guides, and enablement materials to encourage effective adoption and continuous improvement. Optimize development efforts based on user feedback. Stay current with emerging Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot features. Proactively seek out, evaluate, and pilot new AI tools and platforms, assessing their fit, value, and — critically — their compatibility with the organization's regulated environment and data-control requirements before adoption.

Technical Troubleshooting & Support

Diagnose and resolve technical challenges related to Copilot Studio implementations, working closely with internal engineering teams when necessary. Ensure data security in all Power Platform and Copilot-enabled solutions.

Required Qualifications

This is an entry-level position. Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 1-2 years of professional experience, OR equivalent combination of education and experience. Proven success in Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio solution design, development, and deployment. Strong, hands-on working knowledge of modern AI tools — specifically Microsoft Copilot and Claude (and related tools) — including their use for development, automation, and prompt engineering. Experience using Claude locally (outside the Microsoft 365 environment) for AI-assisted development and automation.

Strong familiarity with Teams, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Azure, and their integration points. Familiarity with Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and third-party system integrations Skilled in identifying AI-driven optimization opportunities. Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a regulated environment with strict data controls, balancing AI experimentation against compliance, governance, and data-protection obligations.

A genuine desire to explore, test, and adopt emerging AI tools and platforms. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills. Experience with data integration from multiple sources while maintaining accuracy, quality, and compliance. Understanding of prompt engineering principles and LLM behavior; experience with RAG-based architectures preferred Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including presentation development and delivery. Ability to work independently in a remote-first environment while maintaining strong coworker relationships.

Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. Prior experience working for Microsoft or a Microsoft Gold/Cloud Solutions Partner. Certifications in Microsoft Power Platform, AI, or Copilot-related specialties. Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery models for enterprise technology projects. Knowledge of AI prompt engineering and LLM (Large Language Model) optimization techniques. Experience deploying and governing AI tools — such as Claude and other non-Microsoft models — in regulated or data-sensitive environments.

Work Environment & Travel

Location: United States, Eastern Time Zone Travel: None required. Work Hours: This role is for a United States company. Work will be conducted in English, and can be done asynchronously with the US time zones, though some overlap will be required for meetings and collaboration.

About the Role

This is a strategic consulting role where you will be part of a high-performing, client-focused team dedicated to unlocking the full potential of Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, and a broader set of AI tools including Claude. You will work with organizations to reimagine productivity, streamline workflows, and empower teams with AI-driven insights and automation — always within a regulated environment where strong data controls and responsible AI adoption are non-negotiable.

WHO WE ARE

As pioneers of the seaweed category, we introduced the world’s first line of Certified Organic and Non-GMO Project Verified roasted seaweed snacks in 2012 and has since grown to become the #1 selling, premium, organic seaweed-based snack – but our aspirations reach even further.

Led by founders and visionary food entrepreneurs Annie Chun and Steve Broad, we take great pride and care in creating delicious and convenient snacks inspired by our Korean heritage and believe that seaweed represents a sustainable path forward that nourishes people and the planet.

With our eyes focused on the future, we’re on a mission to increase our impact by winning over a whole new generation of foodies. We are assembling a team of talented and driven individuals who are just as excited about the future of seaweed as we are!

WHO YOU ARE

You understand that trade spend is one of the most important and complex levers in a CPG business. You know how deductions, promotions, distributor activity, retailer programs, and accruals impact the P&L, Balance Sheet, and day-to-day operations. You enjoy bringing structure and clarity to that complexity.

You are highly analytical, detail-oriented, and naturally curious. You ask questions when something doesn’t look right, investigate root causes, and work collaboratively across teams to solve problems. You’re comfortable working in the details of customer chargebacks and trade accruals while also identifying broader trends and opportunities for process improvement.

You thrive in a fast-moving, growing environment where processes are still evolving. You bring organization and accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build scalable systems and workflows.

You’re a strong cross-functional partner who communicates clearly and works effectively with Sales, Finance, Operations, and external partners. You can translate complex financial and operational data into actionable insights that help the business make smarter decisions.

WHAT YOU DO

Trade Promotion Spend Management

  • Ensure all customer trade promotion chargebacks are valid, authorized deductions that are accurately accounted for by customer, promotion, and general ledger account within the trade promotion management (TPM) system
  • Partner closely with the Head of Sales Operations to support promotion planning, execution, and accuracy within the TPM system
  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for the TPM service provider and act as the internal TPM superuser
  • Set up and maintain customer records, SKUs, promotions, and general ledger mappings within the TPM system
  • Upload and validate direct customer sales, distributor shipments, and consumption data into the TPM system
  • Manage automated workflows for incoming customer remittances and chargeback documentation
  • Enter and maintain non-chargeback accounts payable invoices within the TPM system
  • Review, validate, and allocate customer chargebacks to the appropriate promotions while driving process scalability through automation, AI, and outsourced operational support

Trade Spend Accruals & ERP Integration

  • Prepare monthly trade spend accruals by customer, promotion, and general ledger account by analyzing open promotions, planned spend, and chargeback activity within the TPM system in accordance with company accounting policies and GAAP
  • Summarize accruals by channel and general ledger account and review findings with the CFO, Controller, and Accounting Manager
  • Export, validate and reconcile trade promotion spend data from the TPM system for ERP upload and financial reporting and balance sheet accuracy
  • Partner with Accounting to support accurate month-end close processes through detailed reconciliation and variance analysis

Customer Disputes & Deduction Resolution

  • Partner with the TPM service provider to identify, dispute, and resolve invalid customer chargebacks
  • Collaborate with Operations to dispute logistics fines, shortages, and other operational deductions
  • Assist Finance with collections and accounts receivable follow-up related to settled disputes
  • Track deduction trends and root causes to improve recovery rates and reduce future chargebacks

Budgeting, Audit & Financial Support

  • Collaborate with the Head of Sales Operations and Financial Planning & Analysis to develop annual and monthly trade spend budgets by customer, promotion, and general ledger account within the TPM system
  • Support year-end audit requests and provide supporting trade spend documentation as needed
  • Help maintain strong financial controls, documentation, and audit readiness across trade spend processes

Reporting, Insights & Process Improvement

  • Prepare monthly trade spend reporting and variance analysis versus budget and forecast
  • Provide trade spend data, analysis, and insights to external trade spend consultants
  • Support Sales leadership with TPM reporting, analysis, and performance insights
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Operations to improve the efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness of trade spend processes
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and improved reporting capabilities across systems and workflows

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong understanding of trade promotion spend, customer deductions, accrual accounting, and retailer/distributor programs within a CPG environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Operations, and external partners
  • Ability to manage large volumes of transactional data while maintaining accuracy and organization
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly explain financial and operational insights
  • High ownership mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and operating effectively in a fast-paced, evolving business
  • Ability to identify process inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Advanced Excel and data manipulation capabilities; experience working with ERP and TPM systems
  • Interest in leveraging automation, AI, and scalable processes to improve operational efficiency
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field
  • 10+ years of finance and accounting experience, including 5+ years managing trade promotion spend in a CPG food & beverage environment
  • Experience working with trade promotion management (TPM) software
  • Experience working with major food distributors and retailers (eg. UNFI, KeHE, Amazon, Target)
  • Experience identifying and successfully disputing incorrect chargebacks in customer portals
  • Experience with trade spend accrual accounting, balance sheet reconciliations and month-end close processes
  • Advanced Excel, data manipulation skills
  • Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred)

YOUR EXPERIENCE

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

The employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, and lift or move items up to 15 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision for computer work.

This position is primarily a remote position with occasional travel to headquarters located in San Rafael, Ca, Bay Area candidates preferred.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

This full-time role will receive a competitive salary + benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, and equity.   • Coordinate with developers, syndicators/investors, lenders, attorneys, consultants, and government agencies to resolve underwriting questions and obtain required documentation.

jobs.excerpt: The Proportional Representation HubAmerican democracy is at a breaking point.
jobs.description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple––districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Summary

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will design, build, and win the campaigns that will make proportional representation a political reality across the United States, one of the most important democracy reform efforts of the next decade.

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will lead efforts to advance proportional representation through ballot measures and legislative campaigns at the state, city, and county level. This executive will develop and oversee a national portfolio of state and local campaigns, identifying opportunities for breakthrough victories while building long-term political power for the movement. They will work closely with local organizers, advocacy organizations, elected officials, coalition partners, philanthropic investors, and policy experts to build winning campaigns that can serve as models for replication nationwide.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience winning state-level legislative and ballot campaigns, advancing policy reforms through complex political environments, and ideally leading sophisticated local campaigns.

The Vice President of State and Local Campaigns will serve as a member of the organization’s Senior Leadership Team.

This is a role for a senior strategist, movement builder, and campaign leader who understands how to translate ambitious ideas into real-world political victories.

What You’ll Lead

Win State and Local Victories

  • Secure legislative victories, ballot measure wins, municipal reforms, pilot programs, and other policy breakthroughs that move the field forward.
  • Build a growing portfolio of successful campaigns that demonstrate the viability and effectiveness of proportional representation.
  • Identify emerging opportunities and rapidly deploy resources where victories are achievable.

Build and Support State Campaign Infrastructure

  • Develop and manage a national strategy for supporting state and local reform efforts across multiple geographies.
  • Provide strategic guidance, technical assistance, campaign planning, communications support, policy expertise, and political analysis to partners.
  • Help create campaign infrastructure, tools, training programs, and best practices that can be utilized across states and municipalities.
  • Build systems that allow local victories to accelerate broader national momentum.

Build Powerful Coalitions

  • Cultivate strong relationships with state and local advocacy organizations, community leaders, civic groups, labor organizations, democracy reform advocates, academics, elected officials, and grassroots organizers.
  • Build broad-based coalitions capable of advancing reforms through diverse political environments.
  • Help align local, state, and national stakeholders around shared campaign goals and strategic priorities.
  • Foster partnerships that can sustain long-term movement growth beyond individual campaign cycles.

Raise Resources for Campaigns

  • Partner closely with the senior leadership team to secure significant investments in state and local campaign efforts.
  • Help raise funding for campaign partners, coalition efforts, and priority states.
  • Cultivate relationships with major donors, foundations, and philanthropic collaboratives interested in democracy reform.
  • Develop compelling investment cases for emerging campaign opportunities.

Build the Field

  • Position the Proportional Representation Hub as the premier strategic partner and leader for state and local proportional representation efforts nationwide.
  • Elevate successful campaigns through media, thought leadership, conferences, convenings, and strategic communications.
  • Create opportunities for knowledge sharing, collaboration, and movement-wide learning.
  • Help build a durable ecosystem of organizations and leaders advancing proportional representation across the country.

Lead Across the Organization

  • Serve as a senior member of the Executive Leadership Team.
  • Manage campaign staff, consultants, in-state directors, and external partners.
  • Collaborate closely with communications, policy, research, partnerships, and development teams to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Build a culture of excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.

Who You Are

You have spent your career winning difficult state legislative and ballot measure campaigns. You understand how to build winning coalitions and teams across a diversity of geographies and organizations.

You are equally comfortable working with donors as with grassroots leaders and campaign staff.

You understand the rhythm and needs of local campaigns and can support campaigns with everything from strategic guidance to infrastructure-building to training.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15+ years of senior campaign, legislative, political, or advocacy leadership experience.
  • Significant experience managing multi-state strategies and complex campaign portfolios.
  • Demonstrated success winning state legislative campaigns, ballot initiatives, municipal reforms, or other major policy victories.
  • Deep understanding of state and local political systems, legislative processes, and campaign dynamics.

  • Experience managing high-performing teams and complex organizational initiatives.
  • Deep commitment to strengthening American democracy through structural reform.

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a Challenge? Looking for an innovative organization and the opportunity to learn and grow professionally? We can help! We are seeking an Adjunct Faculty Instructor NAV103: Naval Force Design – Fall I semester to support the U.S. Navy Community College (USNCC) Adjunct Faculty Support Services. This is a remote opportunity for a 1099 Contractor / Consultant role offering a flexible schedule. Each course requires a 10-week commitment, dedicating eight (8) hours per week. This includes orientation/onboarding, eight (8) weeks of instruction (six (6) hours per week for instruction plus two (2) office hours per week), and one (1) week for final grading and reporting. Instructors can teach up to two (2) courses per term; first-time instructors are limited to one (1) course per term. The Fall I term runs from August 10, 2026 through October 4, 2026.

I’ve never heard of Terrestris. What do you do?

At Terrestris, we leverage technology to create better mission outcomes through better human performance. We form strong client and team relationships through transparency and strive to create an environment where our team can let their excellence shine through. By finding, developing, and incorporating new ideas, we provide memorable services. Rooted in the USMC values of honor, courage, and commitment, Terrestris seeks to deliver extraordinary value to the American people by helping the Government become more efficient and effective.

So, what will the Adjunct Faculty Instructorat Terrestris do?

The Adjunct Faculty Instructor NAV 103 supports the U.S. Naval Community College (USNCC) by delivering high-quality, fully online asynchronous instruction to enlisted Sailors, Marines, and Coast Guardsmen pursuing college-level education. Faculty members teach Naval Studies and/or General Education courses that strengthen critical thinking, leadership, communication, and operational readiness while supporting the Navy's mission of developing a highly educated and mission-ready force.

USNCC courses are delivered through the Blackboard Learning Management System (LMS) in an 8-week online format. Faculty provide engaging instruction, evaluate student performance, facilitate discussions, and deliver timely, meaningful feedback while maintaining the highest standards of academic excellence and professionalism.

What does a typical day look like for an Adjunct Faculty Instructor?

You will:

  • Attend required onboarding and course orientation prior to teaching.
  • Prepare supplemental materials (no more than 10-15%) with current events and/or relevant past experiences for USNCC Dean and/or Associate Dean of the Academics Program approval; upload all materials onto USNCC LMS.
  • Teach assigned undergraduate-level online asynchronous courses in accordance with USNCC policies, syllabi, and instructional standards.
  • Deliver instruction using the USNCC Blackboard Learning Management System (LMS) using the government-provided course shell that includes instructional materials, core lectures, assignments, rubrics, and threaded discussion topics.
  • Facilitate engaging online discussions that encourage critical thinking and active student participation.
  • Grade assignments, examinations, discussion posts, and projects using established grading rubrics.
  • Provide detailed written feedback that promotes student learning and academic success.
  • Monitor student progress throughout the course and proactively identify students who may be at academic risk.
  • Communicate regularly with students and respond to inquiries within established response time requirements.
  • Maintain weekly virtual office hours and additional flexible office hours as needed to support student success.
  • Prepare a weekly progress report.
  • Submit all grades and required documentation within prescribed deadlines.
  • Prepare end-of-course reports summarizing student performance and recommendations for course improvements.
  • Participate in faculty meetings and collaborate with Course Leads, Academic Affairs, and Student Services when required.
  • Maintain current knowledge within the assigned discipline through professional development, scholarship, research, or participation in professional organizations.
  • Ensure all instructional materials and supplemental content comply with USNCC academic policies, copyright requirements, and Department of the Navy standards.

What qualifications do you look for?

You might be the professional we’re looking for if you have:

  • Authorization to permanently work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Relevant military experience or similar experience in government, and/or working with military personnel.
  • Experience teaching at the collegiate level, in an online learning environment using Learning Management Systems (Blackboard or similar LMS).
  • Appropriate academic credentials and a record of scholarship/research consistent with the assigned teaching role:
    • Demonstrated expertise in the fields of U.S. national security studies, American government, political science, organizational design, naval engineering, and systems engineering.
  • Prior experience teaching courses in U.S. defense strategy/policy, introduction to U.S. politics and government, systems engineering, naval systems design, public policy, and public policy analysis.
  • Required Academic OR Professional Qualifications (see below).

Academic Qualifications:

  • A Master's degree (Doctorate preferred) in a relevant discipline.
  • A minimum of 18 graduate semester hours in the teaching discipline.
  • Previous college-level teaching experience.

Professional Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Specific, high-level professional experience that is directly relevant to the course’s subject matter in a military or related setting, such as prior military service or experience, particularly in positions of service-wide prominence, and when the experience results in renowned expertise that is aligned with the learning outcomes of the course.
  • Demonstrated teaching experience in an online modality for working adults; must include experience teaching one semester-equivalent course specifically in an online higher education environment at an accredited college or university demonstrating strong student and/or peer evaluation.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Andragogy and Adult Learning Theory.
  • Significant and substantive relevant experience in a military or related setting that makes you uniquely or substantively qualified to teach the specific subject area. This will typically include at least 10-15 years of direct field experience, with at least five of those years at a senior leadership level, in the specific course area being taught.

We are extraimpressed by folks with:

  • Military service or civilian Department of Defense experience, particularly Department of the Navy, US Navy, US Marine Corps, or US Coast Guard.
  • Experience working with military personnel.
  • Extensive subject matter expertise in national security, military operations, leadership, history, government, public policy, or related disciplines.

What kind of benefits does Terrestris Offer?

We offer outstanding benefits including health, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, and work-life programs. Our award programs acknowledge employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our service standards. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefit programs. Other offerings may be provided for employees not within this category.

Terrestris is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Banner Health was named to Fortune’s Most Innovative Companies in America 2025 list for the third consecutive year and named to Newsweek's list of Most Trustworthy Companies in America for the second year in a row. We’re proud to be recognized for our commitment to the latest health care advancements and excellent patient care.

Banner Health's Data Platform Team is building the modern data platform that runs on Databricks and AWS, supporting everything from claims and clinical data to population health analytics and AI-enabled by data. We're looking for a Data Architect to lead Databricks solution architecture end to end — designing PHI-compliant data patterns, defining the architectural standards for how data moves from Bronze through Gold and how entity resolution and claims data get handled, and partnering with enterprise and cloud architecture teams to make sure what we build fits inside Banner's broader security posture. You'll be the person in the room when a new data pattern needs a PHI-safe design, and the person who can explain why it's built that way to both a cloud architect and a compliance reviewer. You define the patterns and standards — engineering teams build against them.

This isn't a design-and-hand-off role. You'll work directly with analytics leaders to translate platform capabilities into terms they can act on, and you'll work directly with data engineers on coding standards, CI/CD practices, and Gold-layer development patterns — teaching the practices, not just documenting them. If you can move between an architecture review with enterprise architects and a working session teaching an analytics team how to build a compliant Gold pipeline, and you understand both the technical and healthcare-data complexity underneath each, this is the role. This is a remote position. In this role you would work Monday through Friday normal business hours 8am - 5pm AZ time zone and can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AL, AK, AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, ND, NE, NH, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV & WY.

Your pay and benefits (Total Rewards) are important components of your Journey at Banner Health. Banner Health offers a variety of benefit plans to help you and your family. We provide health and financial security options, so you can focus on being the best at what you do and enjoying your life.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position leads enterprise-scale solution design, ensuring technology strategies align with Banner Health’s mission to deliver safe, efficient, an innovative healthcare services. This role drives the adoption of AI-enabled care models, advanced cloud architectures, and secure, compliant integration of healthcare systems. Mentors junior staff, influences, strategic decisions, and ensures delivery of solutions that enhance patient outcomes and operational performance.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Lead the design of complex, multi-domain healthcare solutions using Azure, AWS, and hybrid architectures.

2. Architect AI/ML-enabled applications for predictive analytics, clinical decision support, and operational efficiency.

3. Define and enforce architecture governance, ensuring adherence to HIPPAA, HITECH, PCI, NIS 800-53, and internal security standards.

4. Develop cloud adoption roadmaps, including Azure Landing Zones or AWS Landing Zones, hybrid connectivity, and more.

5. Evaluate and select vendor solutions, balancing innovation, cost, compliance, and operational readiness.

6. In collaboration with Enterprise Architects, create and maintain architectural artifacts, archetypes, reference architectures, and capability roadmaps for enterprise consumption and integration to the Enterprise Architecture roadmap.

7. Provide thought leadership in AI ethics, data governance, and healthcare-specific deployment strategies.

8. Collaborate with Enterprise Architects, executives, clinicians, and IT Leaders to align technology with business goals.

9. Relentless focus on delivering outcomes and value to our business in partnership with Senior Leadership, stakeholders, and vendor partners to develop architectures, strategies, and guidance in support of strategic initiatives.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
