jobs.title: Senior Game Prototype Developer
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAt YallaPlay, We are a rapidly growing startup mobile gaming studio on a mission to bring people together through play, we create exciting mobile games that bring joy to millions of players worldwide.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At YallaPlay, We are a rapidly growing startup mobile gaming studio on a mission to bring people together through play, we create exciting mobile games that bring joy to millions of players worldwide. Founded in Austin, Texas, we’ve since expanded to Brazil and the UAE, growing our diverse and talented team of creators. We pride ourselves on a fun and collaborative work environment, with a remote-friendly culture and a dedication to producing high-quality, engaging games. Our current titles, including “Spades Masters” (iOS/Android), have been enjoyed by millions of players globally.

Our passion lies in reinventing card games infusing them with fresh mechanics, beautiful design, and social features that spark connection and excitement. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for creative, driven individuals who are excited to help shape the future of multiplayer mobile gaming in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Join us and be part of building something big from the ground up.

The Opportunity

We’re building a new rapid-prototyping capability at YallaPlay focused on turning game ideas into complete playable experiences quickly, using AI to dramatically shorten the path from concept to validation.

We’re looking for a Senior Game Prototype Engineer who can independently design and build game prototypes from A to Z. You’ll sit at the intersection of game design, frontend engineering, backend engineering, and UI/UX, taking an initial concept and turning it into something players can actually play and evaluate.

This is not a role where you wait for detailed game designs, UX specifications, or technical requirements. You’ll define the core gameplay, design the player experience, build the client and supporting backend, create or source the assets needed, and deliver a complete playable prototype.

Your job is not to build production-ready games. It is to identify what needs to be tested and build the fastest complete experience capable of answering that question.

You’ll work heavily with AI coding agents and modern development tools to move from idea → design → prototype → playtest → learning → next experiment at high speed.

Some prototypes will survive. Most won’t. That’s expected. Success means helping us discover which ideas deserve further investment before we commit a full production team.

This position can be remote or based at our state-of-the-art offices in Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Take game ideas from concept to complete playable prototype, owning the process from A to Z.
  • Define and iterate on the core game mechanics, rules, player flows, controls, progression, and overall gameplay experience.
  • Design and implement clear, functional UI/UX that allows players to understand and properly experience the game.
  • Build the frontend, game logic, bots, lightweight backend, multiplayer functionality, and other systems required to make the prototype fully playable.
  • Use existing, generated, or placeholder art, animation, audio, and other assets to create a prototype that feels complete enough to evaluate fairly.
  • Scope ideas down to their smallest meaningful testable version, focusing effort on what needs to be proven rather than building unnecessary features.
  • Own the prototype loop end to end: define the hypothesis, build the experience, run playtests, analyze the results, and recommend whether to iterate, progress, or stop.
  • Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted development tools as a core part of your workflow to dramatically increase development speed.
  • Instrument prototypes with lightweight analytics where needed so decisions can be informed by player behavior as well as qualitative feedback.
  • Iterate rapidly based on playtests, data, and feedback.
  • When a prototype graduates, package the game rules, learnings, technical approach, and playable build for handoff to the production team.
  • Continuously experiment with new AI tools, frameworks, and workflows that improve prototype speed and quality.

What We’re Looking For

What you need to have:

  • 5+ years of professional game development experience, or an exceptional portfolio demonstrating equivalent senior-level capability.
  • A strong portfolio of at least 5 completed playable games, prototypes, game-jam projects, or commercial titles where you had substantial hands-on ownership.
  • Proven ability to independently take a game concept from idea to a complete playable prototype.
  • Strong game-design instincts, including mechanics, rules, pacing, player flows, feedback, and game feel.
  • Strong programming fundamentals with the ability to work across frontend, game logic, and lightweight backend systems.
  • Ability to independently create functional, mobile-friendly UI/UX without relying on dedicated designers.
  • Ability to implement bots, APIs, multiplayer functionality, game-state management, and server-side logic when the prototype requires them.
  • Experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as a core part of your development workflow.
  • Comfortable using AI-generated, existing, or placeholder visual and audio assets to rapidly produce complete playable experiences.
  • Comfortable working independently from an incomplete brief, making both design and technical decisions without detailed specifications.
  • Strong judgment around what to build, what to simplify, and when the evidence says to iterate, progress, or stop.

Nice to have:

  • Experience prototyping card, board, casual, or multiplayer games.
  • Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript and lightweight web game frameworks such as Phaser or PixiJS.
  • Experience with server-authoritative multiplayer systems or hidden-information games.
  • Unity experience.
  • Experience using generative AI for art, animation, audio, or other game assets.
  • Experience with analytics or experimentation tools.
  • Experience taking prototypes through external player testing.

How We Measure Success

Success in this role is not measured by how much production code you write.

It is measured by:

  • Prototype velocity: how quickly meaningful game hypotheses become playable.
  • Learning velocity: how quickly prototypes produce clear answers.
  • Experiment quality: whether prototypes test the right question without unnecessary scope.
  • Decision quality: whether evidence leads to clear iterate, progress, or stop recommendations.
  • AI leverage: how effectively AI tools increase the amount and quality of experimentation one person can deliver.
  • Independence: how effectively you can take an ambiguous concept and move it forward without detailed direction.
  • Handoff quality: whether promising concepts can move into production without losing the important learnings from prototyping.

Why YallaPlay

What You Get

  • Real Impact – You’ll work on meaningful projects that reach a global audience.
  • Collaborative Culture – Small team, big ambition. We keep things fun, respectful, and feedback-driven.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary
  • Remote-first and flexible schedule- Digital nomad friendly
  • Generous paid time off
  • Paid birthdays off
  • UAE visa sponsorship (if applicable)
  • Growth opportunities and access to learning resources
  • A team that actually loves games—and each other

Next Steps

Ready to join the team? We’d love to hear from you!

  • Apply
  • Share sample code and projects (GitHub)

We review every application carefully and will be in touch if there’s a fit. Good luck!

*Resume MUST be in English

Location: Remote - MENA

Role: Account Manager

Department: Sales

Mode: Full-time

About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.

Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.

We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!

Our Culture

At , we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here's what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We're a team!

Role Description

We're hiring our Founding Account Manager for MENA to build 's Account Management function from the ground up.

This is a Day 0 role. There is no existing playbook, no fixed KPIs, and no template to follow. You will work directly with the Head of Department to design how we engage, retain, and grow our self-service customers and small key accounts across the region.

You will spend roughly 70% of your time on our self-service cohort — customers who today have never spoken to a human at — and 30% on a small portfolio of high-potential key accounts. Your job is to move the self-service base from "unmanaged" to "observed and engaged", run monthly engagement experiments, and surface what actually drives retention and expansion in your region.

You will succeed in this role if you are energized by ambiguity, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and excited to be part of a small founding team building something from scratch.

The role

WhatsApp is how business gets done in MENA, and MENA is one of our fastest-growing regions. A big share of our customers bought Respond without ever talking to a human. This changes with you.

Your goal will be to work with our customers to help them expand, retain, and get more value from the platform through onboarding and best practices. This is a one-to-many role where you will learn how to make an impact at scale.

This is an early-stage role. The Account Management function is young: we have a first version of the playbook and early results, but MENA is untouched. You’ll be the first AM in the region, working directly with the executive team, with real room to shape how the playbook evolves as it scales globally.

This is a commercial role. You grow revenue from existing customers and stop revenue from leaving. If you want to own a number and build the machine others will later operate, keep reading.

What you’ll do

Grow the base

  • Own expansion revenue: usage growth, plan upgrades, monthly-to-annual conversions, multi-location rollouts.
  • Find adoption opportunities - help our customers deploy best practices, use AI agents, more platform features.
  • Work from usage and billing signals, because that is where expansion actually converts.
  • Run activation rescue on accounts that bought but never fully deployed.

Defend the base

  • Spot at-risk behavior early and intervene before the cancellation, not after.
  • Analyze every cancellation: find the root cause, document it, and share it with product and revenue leadership.
  • Stabilize high-potential accounts that currently have no dedicated point of contact.
  • Log every account touch from day one. We measure AM impact with data, and your results will be provable, not anecdotal.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years in B2B SaaS AM, CS, or Sales where you held a revenue, expansion, or retention number.
  • Managed a portfolio of 50–100 accounts and know how to focus on the ones that matter most.
  • Fluent English and Spanish; Portuguese a strong plus.
  • Deep familiarity with MENA business culture and the role WhatsApp plays in it.
  • Data-driven by default; fixes broken things without being asked; comfortable operating where the playbook is still being written.
  • Comfortable working regional coverage hours.

What’s in it for you

  • Founding role with direct exposure to the executive team and real influence over the function’s design.
  • Clear growth path: build the MENA playbook and have a team built around you.
  • Base plus variable tied to expansion revenue and retention performance.
  • The ownership of an early-stage role, backed by a profitable and well-funded company.
  • Flexible, remote-friendly environment built for sustainable performance.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Arch Systems is seeking a talented Technical Account Manager to join our rapidly scaling team and help guide our customers in successfully implementing our impactful solutions. This role will support both global customers and those operating in U.S. government and defense environments. Candidates must be based in the United States and a US citizen.

If you're prepared to cultivate and enhance client relationships, lead technical discussions, drive portfolio growth, and thrive in a collaborative and innovative environment, we want to hear from you!

What You Will Own & Drive

  • Support the Customer Success team with pilots, deployments, renewals, and subsequent expansion programs
  • Own projects across account management, program management, and professional services to improve customer satisfaction
  • Track and coordinate technology deployments with customers and partners on a global scale
  • Coordinate between customers and Engineering teams by prioritizing support requests and helping resolve technical and product questions
  • Work directly with customers, alongside Technical Project Managers, Account Managers, and other Applications Engineers at Arch, to deliver successful rollouts and end-to-end solutions, including the Factory Map and across the broader product stack as needed

What You Bring to The Table

  • 3+ years of Account Management or Customer Success experience in an Electronics Manufacturing or SaaS environment, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota and driving strong customer satisfaction
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience with project management methodologies
  • Technical proficiency with Python, database queries, and API usage
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience drawing insights from large data sets
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal and written/verbal communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Cultural sensitivity and demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across teams in Asia, Europe, and the Americas

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience supporting government, defense, or highly regulated industry customers
  • Experience working with GovCloud environments
  • Experience working in or supporting manufacturing operations teams
  • Experience in Network and/or IoT applications
  • Advanced experience with scripting, Python, and complex database queries
  • Strong project management experience around solution deployments
  • Training or instructional experience with customers or internal teams

How We Will Support You

  • Innovate with Impact: Be part of a team developing transformative data products that optimize and revolutionize manufacturing operations globally. Your work will directly impact efficiency, sustainability, and growth for some of the world’s leading industrial companies.
  • Collaborative Environment: Join a passionate, multidisciplinary team that values innovation, open communication, and teamwork. We foster a culture of continuous learning, mutual respect, and cross-functional collaboration, empowering everyone to contribute meaningfully.
  • Growth & Development Opportunities: Advance your career through hands-on experience in product leadership, data-driven decision-making, and technical innovation. Arch supports professional development with pathways for skill enhancement, leadership growth, and increasing product vision expertise.
  • Equity & Ownership: Share in the company’s success through equity ownership, aligning your personal success with Arch’s mission and growth.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: Embrace a remote-first work culture that provides flexibility and balance, supporting productivity and connection in a collaborative virtual environment.

Application Process

Please submit resumes in English. We encourage passionate applicants to apply, even if they don’t meet every qualification. At Arch, we value authenticity and believe in hiring individuals as their full, unique selves. We’re committed to fostering an environment where team members can leverage their strengths while continuously learning and growing. Don’t let imposter syndrome hold you back—if you’re excited about this opportunity, we’d love to hear from you!

About Arch Systems

At Arch Systems, we empower discrete manufacturing facilities with deep data insights that enable optimal efficiency, precise KPIs, and proactive decision-making. We work with leading manufacturers to integrate and optimize their data for actionable intelligence, fueling productivity and operational excellence.

Compensation Practices

Arch Systems is committed to equitable, transparent, and market-competitive compensation. This role is remote-first, and compensation is benchmarked using San Francisco Bay Area market data as the reference point for our pay ranges.

The San Francisco Bay Area total compensation range for this position is $115,000 - $155,000 based upon qualifications and experience.

For candidates based outside the Bay Area, compensation may be geo-adjusted based on location-specific market data, cost of labor, and local market practices. Final compensation is determined by job-related factors including experience, skills, scope of responsibility, and performance expectations, in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws.

In addition to cash compensation, this role may be eligible for equity awards, aligning individual impact with Arch Systems' long-term success.

For U.S.-based employees, benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, retirement contributions, and additional programs that support wellbeing and professional development.

International candidates hired through our approved global employment partners will receive regionally competitive benefits and are eligible for non-qualified stock options (NQSOs) from Arch Systems, allowing participation in the company's long-term success.

Remote Equal

Arch champions a remote-first work environment since its inception, promoting flexibility and inclusivity across all teams. While we welcome talent from diverse locations, we currently do not offer visa sponsorship.

Arch is committed to full compliance with regulations from the Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) to ensure alignment with all applicable sanctions programs. This means we do not engage in transactions or employment practices that conflict with OFAC regulations, including the hiring of individuals residing in regions subject to US sanctions.

Salary: $115,000 – $155,000

jobs.excerpt: Job OverviewOur client is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Credentialing Specialist to manage provider credentialing, payer enrollment, insurance contracting, and provider record maintenance.
jobs.description:
Job Overview

Our client is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Credentialing Specialist to manage provider credentialing, payer enrollment, insurance contracting, and provider record maintenance. The role will serve as a primary resource for credentialing activities and will ensure providers remain properly enrolled, credentialed, and compliant with applicable insurance payers.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience independently managing the provider credentialing process from application through approval and ongoing maintenance, with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Job Details

  • Work set up:Work from Home
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday | 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM PH Time | Flexible to an extent
  • Holiday: Follows U.S. holidays

Responsibilities:

Provider Credentialing & Enrollment

  • Manage all aspects of initial provider credentialing and recredentialing with commercial insurance companies, Medicare, Medicaid, and other contracted payers.
  • Complete and track payer enrollment applications from submission through approval.
  • Update and add new providers, supervising physicians, and practice locations to payer contracts as required.
  • Maintain provider credentialing information in CAQH, NPPES, PECOS, state licensing boards, DEA registrations, malpractice coverage, and other applicable registries.
  • Monitor provider credentialing expiration dates and proactively complete renewals and revalidations to prevent lapses in provider participation.
  • Coordinate credentialing and payer enrollment activities for newly hired providers.
  • Follow up with insurance companies and credentialing organizations regarding application status, outstanding documentation, and enrollment issues.
  • Research payer-specific credentialing requirements and communicate requirements and updates to leadership.
  • Maintain accurate and organized credentialing files, documentation, and tracking systems.
  • Assist with adding new practice locations and services to payer contracts as the organization grows.
  • Maintain accurate provider information within AthenaOne and other internal systems.
  • Assist with credentialing audits and respond to payer requests for additional documentation.
  • Identify and communicate potential credentialing or payer enrollment issues that could affect provider participation.

Insurance Contracting & Payer Relations

  • Review and maintain payer contracts and provider participation information.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for credentialing-related communication with insurance companies, credentialing organizations, and provider enrollment representatives.
  • Maintain professional relationships with payer representatives and follow up consistently on outstanding credentialing matters.
  • Work collaboratively with providers and leadership to obtain required credentialing documentation.
  • Assist leadership with research related to new insurance networks and payer participation opportunities.
  • Assist with adding providers and locations to existing payer contracts.
  • Monitor payer requirements and communicate changes that may affect provider enrollment or participation.

Provider Onboarding

  • Coordinate credentialing and payer enrollment activities for newly hired providers.
  • Obtain and organize all required provider documentation for credentialing and enrollment.
  • Track the status of each provider throughout the credentialing process and communicate updates to leadership.
  • Ensure providers are properly enrolled with applicable payers prior to providing services that require insurance participation.
  • Maintain complete and accurate provider credentialing files throughout employment.

Quality Care

  • Maintain the strictest confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.
  • Maintain a broad knowledge of provider credentialing requirements, insurance plans, payer regulations, and applicable Federal and State requirements.
  • Ensure all credentialing activities are conducted in accordance with Federal, State, and payer regulations, guidelines, and requirements.
  • Recognize and support patients' rights and responsibilities in the performance of job duties while respecting their privacy and confidentiality.
  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation in accordance with company policies and payer requirements.
  • Be prepared to undertake additional credentialing, payer relations, and administrative projects as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and a team-oriented mindset.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or General Education Degree (GED) equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3 years of dedicated medical provider credentialing experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing provider credentialing from application through payer approval and ongoing maintenance.
  • Hands-on experience with CAQH, NPPES, PECOS, Medicare and Medicaid enrollment, commercial insurance credentialing and contracting, state licensing, and DEA registrations.
  • Experience managing provider recredentialing, payer revalidations, and credentialing renewals.
  • Experience communicating directly with commercial insurance companies and payer enrollment representatives.
  • Behavioral health and/or addiction medicine credentialing experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience with AthenaOne or other healthcare EMR/practice management systems preferred.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple providers, payers, applications, deadlines, and credentialing requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively with providers, insurance representatives, credentialing organizations, and internal staff.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Self-directed, dependable, and able to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

Company Description

TechSmart is a pioneering AI software and workforce development company transforming the public K–12 school system into a launchpad for future-ready talent. We partner with school districts across the country providing AI and Software Development curriculum, teacher training, and a platform which prepares students for both entry-level jobs requiring strong AI skills and positions in emerging high-demand tech fields.

AI is transforming industries at an unprecedented pace, reshaping how we learn, work, and engage with technology. As AI continues to drive innovation and job growth across the nation, we are seeing the early stages of significant AI adoption among school districts nationwide.

To support this transformation, we are expanding our partnerships with districts nationwide — ensuring that every school and teacher has the tools, training, and guidance to implement AI and computer science programs with confidence and lasting success.

Position Overview

We are looking for a motivated, organized, and highly collaborative Inside Sales Specialist to help expand TechSmart’s partnerships with public school districts nationwide.

The primary focus of this role is generating and advancing new-business opportunities through strategic district outreach, meeting development, pipeline management, and close collaboration with TechSmart’s sales team. You will research prospective districts, engage school and district leaders, coordinate sales activity, and help move opportunities from initial outreach through proposal development and contracting.

This is a consultative sales role for someone who is eager to develop deep expertise in AI education, workforce development, and the K–12 market. You will work closely with experienced sales team members to understand district priorities, identify strong-fit opportunities, and communicate how TechSmart can help schools prepare students for an AI-driven economy.

As you build product knowledge, market expertise, and sales experience, you will also begin taking ownership of selected renewal and expansion opportunities with existing district partners. This progression provides a pathway to develop full-cycle sales experience and grow into more senior responsibilities within the team.

This role is ideal for someone who combines persistence and strong execution with curiosity, judgment, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in helping schools expand access to future-ready learning opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

District Outreach & Pipeline Development

  • Research prospective school districts, education leaders, funding opportunities, and market developments to identify strong-fit sales opportunities.
  • Execute strategic outbound outreach through phone, email, virtual meetings, and other channels to engage district administrators, CTE leaders, curriculum leaders, and other decision-makers.
  • Generate qualified meetings and new-business opportunities for TechSmart’s outside sales team.
  • Develop personalized outreach strategies informed by district priorities, workforce needs, existing programs, available funding, and potential implementation opportunities.

Opportunity & Sales Process Management

  • Manage assigned prospects and early-stage opportunities, maintaining consistent follow-through, clear next steps, and an organized pipeline.
  • Partner with outside sales team members to research district needs, prepare for meetings and presentations, coordinate follow-up, and advance opportunities through the sales process.
  • Coordinate proposals, agreements, and other sales documentation while maintaining accurate opportunity records and activity updates in Salesforce.
  • Contribute to pipeline reviews and forecasting by providing timely, accurate updates and proactively identifying opportunities requiring additional engagement or support.

Renewal, Expansion & Sales Growth

  • Support selected renewal and expansion opportunities by researching district needs, coordinating outreach and meetings, and assisting with proposals and follow-up.
  • As product knowledge and sales capabilities develop, progressively assume ownership of selected renewal and expansion opportunities from discovery through close.
  • Build the relationship-management, consultative-selling, and full-cycle sales skills needed to take on broader opportunity ownership over time.

Cross-Team Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with outside sales team members, AI Program Managers, and other internal teams to coordinate opportunity strategy, customer communication, and transitions into implementation.
  • Develop deep expertise in TechSmart’s AI and Software Development programs, the K–12 market, education funding, and district workforce-readiness priorities.
  • Share prospect feedback, market insights, and emerging opportunities with the broader team to strengthen sales messaging, processes, and strategy.
  • Continuously refine outreach, communication, and opportunity-management practices through coaching, performance data, feedback, and team collaboration.

Preferred Background and Experience

We are looking for someone who combines strong communication and relationship-building skills with disciplined execution, curiosity, and the ability to learn a complex market quickly.

  • Sales or Business Development Experience: 2 or more years of experience in sales, business development, account management, or another customer-facing role. SaaS, EdTech, or K–12 sales experience is preferred.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, authentically, and professionally with school and district leaders.
  • Relationship Building: Ability to establish credibility, develop trust, and sustain productive relationships through consistent follow-through.
  • Operational Excellence: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple prospects, opportunities, deadlines, and follow-up activities with consistency and precision.
  • Learning Agility: Motivated to develop deep expertise in TechSmart’s programs, the K–12 education market, AI, workforce development, and consultative sales practices.
  • Sales Process Discipline: Comfortable working within a structured sales process and maintaining accurate, timely CRM records. Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM is preferred.
  • Ownership and Initiative: Proactive, dependable, and comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes while asking for guidance when needed.
  • Collaboration: Able to work effectively as part of a highly collaborative, team-based sales organization.
  • Integrity: Committed to communicating honestly, treating customers and colleagues respectfully, and doing things the right way for the right reasons.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required.

Why Join TechSmart?

  • Make an impact: Help expand access to AI and Software Development education for students and teachers across the country.
  • Develop meaningful expertise: Build knowledge at the intersection of AI, workforce development, K–12 education, and consultative sales.
  • Grow your career: Develop from pipeline generation and sales support into ownership of renewal, expansion, and full-cycle sales opportunities
  • Join a collaborative team: Work within a strategic, expertise-driven sales organization that values teamwork, continuous improvement, and shared success.

Interested in Joining Us?

jobs.title: Mid-Level Software Engineer – C#
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT VICTORY LIVE Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory.
jobs.description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer to build and maintain features across our C# and .NET services. You'll own well-scoped pieces of our B2B marketplace and ticketing platform end to end, from design through production, working closely with senior engineers who'll help you level up.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ship features. Build and maintain services in ASP.NET Core, from a scoped design through code review to production.
  • Write tests that hold. Cover your code with xUnit so regressions show up in CI, not in production.
  • Debug production issues. Use logs, metrics, and Datadog dashboards to trace bugs to root cause.
  • Work within our data layer. Write efficient Entity Framework Core queries and migrations that don't lock production tables.
  • Handle messaging and background work. Build and monitor jobs on RabbitMQ or Kafka.
  • Take code review seriously. Review teammates' PRs and act on the feedback you get on your own.
  • Use AI tooling daily. Pair with Claude Code and Copilot for scaffolding, tests, and debugging, and learn where to trust them and where not to.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2–4 years building production software, with at least 1–2 years in C# and .NET.
  • Comfortable building REST APIs with ASP.NET Core.
  • Solid grasp of xUnit (or NUnit) and test-driven development.
  • Working knowledge of Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, and relational databases.
  • Growing but genuine use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exposure to RabbitMQ, Kafka, or other messaging systems.
  • Familiarity with Redis or Azure services.
  • Interest in ticketing, marketplaces, or high-transaction consumer platforms.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.

Our client is a modern survey programming company that helps consultants and investors get deep insights faster, so they can make great decisions. Our client is designed for authoring and launching time-critical market research surveys in record speeds so that their clients can quickly build N and have results sooner.

Our client's solution provides consultants and investors with access to quantitative survey insights on a daily basis. Their clients leverage their custom-built platform and survey engineering team to launch surveys, and gather insights, faster than their competition.

Our client's leadership team comes from the consulting and investment worlds, bringing a strong understanding of the challenges that come with conducting primary research on short timelines. This understanding informs the continued evolution of our client's solution to this day, an understanding that their team is ready and able to run through walls to help clients accomplish their goals. Our client's team is proud to be fully remote since their founding in 2016, with survey directors placed in over 40 cities worldwide.

The Role

As a Survey Director, you will play a pivotal role in driving our client's survey programming projects to success. This is a dynamic role that blends individual contribution, project management, client engagement, and account management. You will be at the forefront of ensuring that clients receive the highest quality survey programming services, from initial design to final data analysis.

The Responsibilities

  • Individual Contribution: Leverage your Python programming skills to contribute directly to survey programming and data analysis tasks, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in every project.
  • Project Management: Manage 3-5 simultaneous projects in a fast-paced environment, coordinating with external vendors to deliver respondents for surveys. Ensure timely and precise delivery of survey results, meeting or exceeding client expectations.
  • Client Engagement:
    • Pre-launch: Guide clients on the optimal structure for their survey projects, helping them align survey design with their research objectives.
    • Launch: Work closely with clients during live survey creation, overseeing questionnaire development and key survey elements. Lead the quality assurance process to ensure all logic, conditionality, and programming elements are correctly implemented and functional.
    • Analytics: Analyze survey data and provide clients with actionable insights, helping them draw meaningful conclusions from their research.
  • Account Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, providing hands-on support for urgent changes or updates as needed. Develop and maintain client accounts, ensuring satisfaction and fostering ongoing partnerships.
  • Product Management: Identify and flag patterns, optimize processes, and localize products based on client feedback and needs. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our client’s services.
  • Client Guidance: Offer expert advisory on survey design and content, helping clients achieve their research goals effectively and efficiently.
  • Special Projects: Engage in special projects or other tasks as required, contributing to innovation and the continuous enhancement of our client’s offerings.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in any field, preferably in engineering, information technology, business, economics, or international relations. Master's degree would be an advantage.
  • Understanding and/or experience with Python and/or JavaScript programming.
  • Proven client-facing experience with a customer-centric approach, strong teamwork skills, a sense of urgency, and a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
  • Business acumen in private markets, including knowledge of private equity, due diligence processes, and the role of primary research in these areas.

Benefits

  • Innovation at Speed: Be a part of a company that is setting new benchmarks in survey programming, working with cutting-edge technology and high-profile clients.
  • Global Impact: Work with some of the most prestigious consulting firms and private equity clients across the globe.
  • Growth Opportunities: Have the chance to expand your skills, manage complex projects, and contribute to the strategic growth of the company.
  • Collaborative Environment: Join a team that values collaboration, innovation, and client satisfaction above all.

If you are a motivated, client-focused professional with a passion for delivering top-tier survey programming services, we encourage you to apply. Join our client and help them continue to redefine the industry standard.

jobs.excerpt: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
jobs.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

jobs.excerpt: The RoleWolf is looking for a Partnerships & Business Operations Manager to help turn important partnerships and company initiatives into products and experiences people can actually play.
jobs.description:
The Role

Wolf is looking for a Partnerships & Business Operations Manager to help turn important partnerships and company initiatives into products and experiences people can actually play.

Signing a partnership is only the beginning. Teams need to align, decisions need to get made, assets and approvals need to arrive, and product, engineering, creative, commercial, and partner work all need to stay connected. Your job is to help make that happen.

You’ll work directly with Wolf’s founders and across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, Legal, and external partner teams. You’ll help create structure around ambiguous work, turn conversations into action, and make sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.

You’ll sit close to the center of the business, seeing firsthand how partnerships become products and how product, technology, creative, commercial, and audience strategy come together. Some days that means thinking through a new opportunity; others, it means tracking down a missing asset or decision blocking a launch.

Wolf is still early, and the partnerships, products, and ways we operate are being built today. You’ll start with defined pieces of important initiatives and take on increasingly meaningful ownership as you demonstrate judgment, reliability, and follow-through.

What You’ll Do

Turn Partnerships Into Products

  • Help move partnerships from agreement or idea through development, launch, and expansion.
  • Turn partner conversations and commitments into clear owners, actions, and next steps.
  • Keep track of deliverables, assets, approvals, timelines, and dependencies across Wolf and partner teams.
  • Prepare for partner meetings, capture decisions, and make sure follow-ups happen.
  • Build strong relationships with partner teams and grow into a trusted day-to-day counterpart.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

  • Help build and manage plans for partner initiatives, products, and launches.
  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Creative, Marketing, and external teams.
  • Keep owners, milestones, decisions, and dependencies organized and visible.
  • Notice when something is blocked, unclear, or falling behind and help get it resolved.
  • Make sure decisions turn into action and that important details don’t fall through the cracks.
  • Adapt as priorities, requirements, and timelines change.

Learn What Works

  • Help define what success looks like for launches and partner initiatives.
  • Gather performance data, partner feedback, and lessons from what we ship.
  • Help the team understand what worked, what didn’t, and what we should do differently next time.
  • Carry lessons from one partnership or launch into the next.
  • Help identify opportunities to grow successful partnerships.

Help Build the Machine

  • Notice recurring problems, inefficiencies, and places where ownership is unclear.
  • Help create simple playbooks, workflows, templates, and tools that make execution easier.
  • Improve how Wolf keeps track of commitments, decisions, and next steps.
  • Make the team more organized and effective without adding unnecessary processes.
  • Take on increasingly ambiguous and important projects as you learn the business and earn trust.

What Success Looks Like

90 days in:

  • A strong understanding of Wolf’s partnerships, products, teams, and how work moves from idea to launch.
  • Partner initiatives where you’ve kept deliverables, decisions, and owners organized and moving.
  • Internal and external relationships where people increasingly trust you to follow through and get the right people aligned.

6 months in:

  • A partner initiative or launch where you’ve independently driven meaningful pieces of the work from planning through execution.
  • A complex project where you identified a blocker, dependency, or missing decision early and helped resolve it.
  • A process, tool, or workflow you’ve improved to make partnership execution more effective.

By the end of your first year:

  • A major partner product or initiative you helped take from idea to launch.
  • A partner relationship where you’ve become a trusted operating counterpart and helped identify opportunities for continued growth.
  • Lessons, processes, or playbooks from your work that have materially improved how Wolf executes future partnerships and launches.

The ultimate measure is simple: Wolf should be able to take on more ambitious work with more partners because you’re part of the team.

Who We’re Looking For

We care more about how you think, work, and learn than about a specific career path. You’re likely to thrive here if:

  • You are exceptionally organized. You keep track of details, commitments, and deadlines, and rarely let things fall through the cracks.
  • You learn quickly. You’re curious, ask good questions, and can get up to speed on unfamiliar products, technologies, and business problems.
  • You’re great with people. You communicate clearly, build relationships easily, and are comfortable working with different personalities and functions.
  • You turn ambiguity into action. When something isn’t clearly defined, your instinct is to figure out what’s needed and what should happen next.
  • You follow through. If you say you’ll do something, people can trust that it will get done.
  • You’re a clear communicator. You can listen to a complicated conversation and pull out the important decisions, questions, and next steps.
  • You notice things. Missing information, unclear ownership, potential problems, and loose ends tend to stand out to you.
  • You have good judgment—and want to develop more of it. You’re comfortable making progress independently but know when to ask questions or pull someone in.
  • You’re willing to do whatever the work requires. You’re as comfortable thinking through a bigger problem as you are tracking down a missing asset or following up on an overdue decision.
  • You want responsibility. You’re early in your career and excited by the opportunity to learn quickly, prove yourself, and earn increasingly significant ownership.

This could be a great role for someone with roughly 2-5 years of experience, but we care more about capability, trajectory, and demonstrated ownership than tenure.

Relevant backgrounds might include:

  • Business or startup operations
  • Strategy & operations
  • Partnerships
  • Program or project management
  • Product operations
  • Consulting
  • Implementation or solutions
  • Media, entertainment, gaming, or technology

We’re especially interested in people who have taken ownership of something and made it happen—whether that means shipping a cross-functional project, coordinating internal and external stakeholders, building a useful process or system, or becoming the person a team relied on to keep complicated work moving.

Compensation: $35-45/hour, depending on experience

This role starts as a 90-day contract, at which point we can assess mutual fit and discuss conversion to a full-time role with benefits.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on, AI Security engineer / developer, to support our Enterprise AI Security Program. Our AI landscape spans everything from internal chatbot pilot to a full agentic workflow with tool access, Code Assistant rollout to thousands of developers to new Agentic platform. Externally, the tools and protocols worth worrying about change every few months. You'll be the person who can look at both ends of that spread ensuring safe and secure adoption of AI.

Required:

  • Strong SWE, with 5+ years of experience; proficiency in Python (or equivalent)
  • 3+ years in AI/ML or GenAI security (prompt injection defense, unsafe output handling, tool-use abuse, data leakage), or equivalent hands-on infosec experience with a demonstrated pivot into AI security.
  • Demonstrated ability to write security policy that is specific and testable, and to translate it into automated enforcement (policy-as-code, CI/CD gates, gateway-level controls, DLP rules) rather than a document that relies on voluntary compliance.
  • A track record of self-directed learning on fast-moving technical topics — comfortable digging into how a brand-new tool, protocol, or framework actually works (architecture, trust boundaries, auth model) well enough to give a defensible security opinion on it within days, not months.
  • Working knowledge of AI/LLM security risks: prompt injection, jailbreaking, unsafe outputs, tool-use abuse, identity misuse, agentic workflow escalation.
  • Hands-on familiarity with AI security frameworks: NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Top 10 / OWASP Agentic Top 10.
  • Experience with cloud security across at least two of AWS, GCP, and Azure, including native AI/ML security tooling (Bedrock Guardrails, Vertex AI floor settings, Azure AI Content Safety).
  • Identity and access management fundamentals — OAuth 2.0/2.1, OIDC, mTLS — with interest in or exposure to non-human/workload identity (SPIFFE/SPIRE) and agent identity models.
  • Experience in a highly regulated industry (healthcare, financial services) with HIPAA or equivalent compliance obligations.
  • Strong technical writing — you can turn a vendor capability gap or a new tool's risk profile into a control requirement someone else can implement and test.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or A2A protocol security, or with AI gateway products (Kong AI Gateway, Azure APIM GenAI Gateway, Apigee).
  • Exposure to AI-native runtime security platforms (Straiker, Palo Alto Prisma AIRS, Virtue AI) or classic content guardrail products.
  • Familiarity with shadow-AI / BYOAI risk — e.g., locally-run autonomous agent frameworks (OpenClaw and similar), unsanctioned browser extensions, personal AI accounts used for work — and how to discover and govern them at scale (CrowdStrike Falcon, Wiz, CASB, or similar).
  • AI red-team tooling experience (PyRIT, Promptfoo, AgentDojo, or custom harnesses).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI or equivalent DLP-for-AI tooling.
  • Relevant certification (CAISP, ISACA AAISM) or equivalent demonstrated skill.
  • Experience with detection engineering, SIEM integration, and telemetry design for AI/agent behavior.

About the Role

We are looking for highly motivated individuals who are passionate about education and helping students navigate the highly competitive BS/MD and BS/DO admissions process. Working alongside a College Advisor, the BS/MD Advisor will mentor high school students throughout the application process, helping them develop school lists, craft compelling "Why Medicine?" essays, brainstorm and edit supplemental essays, prepare for interviews, and provide strategic guidance from start to finish.

Because our students are specifically pursuing direct medical programs, we are seeking advisors who successfully completed a U.S. BS/MD, BA/MD, BS/DO, or BA/DO program themselves. Advisors who have firsthand experience navigating these programs are uniquely positioned to guide students through the process.

The goal is to help students submit polished, authentic applications that align with their academic profile and long-term goals.

Responsibilities:

The BS/MD advisor will work with students in several capacities:

  • develop a strong working relationship with the college advisor, acting as a unified team that will support the applicant through the application process
  • evaluate candidacy of high school students looking to apply to BS/MD programs. This includes evaluation of their GPA, SAT/ACT scores, completed courses, extracurricular activities, and experiences
  • edit the applicant's BS/MD personal statement and BS/MD supplemental essay questions
  • collaborate with applicant to create a customized BS/MD school list that aligns with the student’s candidacy, goals, and preferences
  • prepare students for admissions interviews
  • advise students throughout the application process, implementing proactive measures like consistent check-ins, thorough editing, and timelines/deadlines
  • manage family expectations and enlist them as part of the larger team supporting the student
  • assist students with developing personal responsibility and managing their work
  • offer your expertise and guidance on key application questions and situations

Students can sign up early enough to create year-round work, however, peak season is typically from late August until mid-January. You will be expected to work with multiple clients at one time and need to commit to working with the client until their package or service is complete, which can take upwards of a year. This is a remote position that requires you to have a reliable connection to the Internet and access to Microsoft Word.

Qualifications

  • MD or DO physician (attending preferred; residents and fellows will also be considered)
  • Required: Successful graduate of a U.S. direct medical program (BS/MD, BA/MD, BS/DO, or BA/DO)
  • Demonstrated firsthand knowledge of the BS/MD or BS/DO admissions process
  • Experience mentoring or advising students applying to medical school or direct medical programs
  • Admissions committee experience strongly preferred
  • Strong editing and writing skills, particularly with college and BS/MD application materials
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with high school students and their families
  • High level of emotional intelligence and professionalism
  • Comfortable managing multiple students throughout an application cycle
  • Proficiency with Zoom, Google Meet, and other online collaboration tools

This is a high-touch role. Our clients and fellow advisors value efficient and comprehensive work, which includes a hands-on approach and supporting clients in creating original and compelling application materials. Advisors should be prepared to be flexible and accommodating, when reasonable requests are made. Most importantly, advisors must be sensitive to the emotional needs of the family and student. This is a stressful and busy time for everyone involved, especially the student. It is important that the advisor has the ability to build a trusting and positive relationship with the student and can deliver feedback and guidance in an age-appropriate and constructive manner.

MedSchoolCoach is a rapidly growing EdTech company that serves the needs of future physicians by providing the highest quality content, tutoring, and advising services. Physician-led and founded, MedSchoolCoach is driven by its mission to help shape the future of medicine. Over time, the organization has become one of the largest players in the medical space, reaching nearly 50% of prospective medical students every year through at least one of our products or services.

As an organization, MedSchoolCoach stays true to its roots while continuing to scale, adding more products and services on a continuing basis. MedSchoolCoach has been named repeatedly on Inc Magazine’s 2022 Inc 5000 list and is a fast-growing company. We are grounded in our desire to offer prospective doctors the tools they need to succeed while providing an exceptional learning and mentoring experience.

Working for MedSchoolCoach:

We are a distributed team of creative, approachable, and motivated entrepreneurs, educators, tutors, advisors, and clinicians who are passionate about improving healthcare and education. At MedSchoolCoach, we value problem solvers who take initiative, communicate earnestly, work effectively, and prioritize life-work balance. We do everything we can to make sure our teammates are successful personally and professionally. We welcome all employee contributions in whatever shape or form they manifest, especially as our organization continues to grow. Our team is rapidly growing and we are creating more opportunities for our team. We invite you to apply and grow with us!

While we appreciate the time and effort you take in your application, we can only contact applicants who are moving forward in the selection process.

Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)
