jobs.description:
Шукаємо Motion Designer-a на проєктну роботу 4–6 тижнів в команду 6037, який(-а) допоможе створювати AI-generated відео та анімовані візуали для рекламних креативів. Стартуємо новий напрям у ніші longevity і разом з ним — тест нових для нас платформ: TikTok та Applovin.

Переваги позиції:

  • Гнучкість — ти сам(-а) обираєш, коли працювати.
  • Вплив на результат: твої відео побачать тисячі користувачів і напряму вплинуть на ефективність рекламних кампаній. Ти бачиш перформанс своїх креативів і швидко ітеруєш.
  • Свобода в інструментах: більшість продакшену йде через AI, ми підтримуємо автоматизацію і допоможемо зібрати пайплайн (у тому числі через Claude).
  • Можливість експериментувати, тестувати гіпотези та працювати з трендовими форматами на площадках, які ми тільки відкриваємо.

Твої майбутні виклики:

  • AI-генерація відеоконтенту (Seedance, Kling) і монтаж в After Effects — створення креативів з нуля.
  • Анімації: face/body scanner, анімація плашок, субтитри.
  • Створення end card / playable під Applovin: інтерактивний пекшот або міні-гра в HTML. Зазвичай робиться статичний креатив, який далі перетворюється в HTML, або збирається з графічних елементів у внутрішніх інструментах Applovin.
  • Адаптація відео з Meta під Applovin: там ліміт 59 секунд, тому частину роликів треба скорочувати по скрипту і перегенеровувати окремі шматки.
  • Взаємодія з креативними маркетологами, участь у брейнштормах та створенні концептів.

Що для нас важливо:

  • Сильний досвід використання AI-інструментів для генерації відео — Seedance, Kling або аналоги. Це ключова вимога: більшість продакшену йде саме через них.
  • Від 2-х років з After Effects.
  • Перформанс-мислення: розумієш, що таке hook і retention у відео, чому одна версія працює, а інша ні.
  • Вміння працювати структуровано, вкладатися в дедлайни та робити задачі «під ключ». Проєкт короткий, ітерації щоденні.

Буде перевагою:

  • Досвід з Applovin: playable, end card, базове розуміння HTML.
  • Досвід створення відео для TikTok / UGC форматів.
  • Навички роботи зі звуком (озвучка, саунд-дизайн).

Портфоліо — обовʼязкове. Винеси в ньому релевантні приклади:

  • AI-згенеровані відео, бажано таймінг 20 секунд і більше.
  • Реклама діджитал-продуктів (апки, підписки, сервіси).
  • Якщо є playable або end card під Applovin — покажи окремо.

Процес найму:

Перегляд портфоліо → інтервʼю з командою → офер. Тестового завдання немає — оцінюємо по роботах.

Про нас

6037 — венчурне партнерство, що інвестує в перспективні продукти на ранніх етапах. Ми перетворюємо стартапи на ефективні та стійкі бізнеси за допомогою маркетингової, аналітичної та операційної експертизи.

Наша місія — перетворити Україну з аутсорс-хабу на країну продуктів. Ми націлені побудувати портфель продуктових лідерів у своїх нішах із сукупною кількістю користувачів 1 мільярд.

Наші цінності:

  • Optimism. Наші люди сприймають кар'єру як марафон. Вони не збавляють темп навіть тоді, коли складно, бо розуміють: у фіналі — досягнення великої цілі.
  • Ownership. У 6037 немає запасних. Кожен відповідає за свою ділянку маршруту, бо від особистого внеску кожного залежить успіх усієї команди.
  • Diligence. Ми працюємо за принципом команд Формули-1, де швидкість поєднана з точністю. Ми мислимо логічно у цифрах і дослідженнях, бо віримо, що глибина аналізу формує стабільну перевагу.

Що нас відрізняє:

Ми не обіцяємо те, чого не можемо виконати. Не гарантуємо легкого шляху чи поверхневого комфорту. Натомість пропонуємо траєкторію до відчутних результатів.

  • Змагання у Вищій лізі. Якщо 6037 працює з продуктом, то тільки для того, аби змагатися з лідерами на світовій арені. Працювати тут — це змагатися на чемпіонаті світу. Саме тому ми шукаємо людей з ментальністю атлета, готових викладатися та боротися за перше місце.
  • Спільнота сильних. Командний результат залежить від кожного гравця. Тут люди задають високу планку собі й іншим та спонукають одне одного розвиватися.
  • Компенсація залежить від результату. Винагорода залежить не від кількості годин, а від якості роботи. Замість порожніх обіцянок ми даємо чітке розуміння, скільки й за який результат зароблятимеш.

Проєкт короткий, але це вхідна точка: якщо спрацюємось на TikTok та Applovin — є що робити далі.

Витисни максимум зі своєї карʼєри — приймай виклик та надсилай CV і портфоліо.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote design accelerator apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end design and research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks build and launch their startup or business idea.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested launching a digital app, AI app, or digital business/startup
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

About Peak Financial Planning

Peak Financial Planning is a fee-only fiduciary financial planning firm specializing in helping pre-retirees and retirees make smarter decisions about retirement income, taxes, Social Security, investments, and long-term spending.

YouTube is the media engine behind Peak Financial Planning. Led by founder and CEO Eric Amzalag, CFP®, RICP®, our educational content reaches hundreds of thousands of viewers and generates millions of dollars of investment into the company each month.

Our mission is to become the most trusted retirement-planning media brand in the country.

We produce high-performance, long-form educational content designed to help people make better retirement decisions, deepen trust in the Peak brand, and generate measurable business impact throughout the firm.

Our content is not vanity media. It is the primary way prospective clients discover Peak, learn how we think, and decide whether our planning process is right for them.

We operate through structured workflows, disciplined production systems, clear performance metrics, and an aggressive commitment to innovation—especially through AI-native research, production, and optimization systems.

We are building a repeatable content machine that compounds: stronger ideas, better packaging, higher-quality videos, faster iteration, more qualified prospects, and deeper brand equity over time.

If you’re joining Peak Financial Planning, you’re not here to simply manage a YouTube channel. You’re here to help build the leading retirement-planning media brand in the country.

Role

The YouTube Manager exists to turn Peak Financial Planning’s business priorities, audience insights, and financial-planning expertise into long-form videos that perform at their ceiling and generate measurable business outcomes.

This is a true channel-owner seat for the Eric at Peak Financial Planning YouTube channel. You will have meaningful input upstream on ideas, angles, series concepts, livestreams, clip channel and formats, informed by performance data and a deep understanding of what retirement-focused viewers respond to.

You will help shape what gets made and how it gets recorded so that YouTube performance is built in from the start—not bolted on at the end.

This is not a channel babysitter or packaging-only position. You will own titles, thumbnails, metadata, upload operations, livestream operations, analytics, and back-catalogue optimization. You will be accountable for subscriber growth, booked consultations, and YouTube’s contribution to Peak’s client-acquisition engine.

Views and click-through rate are inputs, not the ultimate goal. The goal is to attract the right viewers, build trust at scale, and convert attention into qualified prospective clients.

The role is AI-forward by default. Analytics, reporting, A/B-test tracking, competitive research, and optimization workflows should increasingly run through AI agents and automation—not manual spreadsheets and gut instinct.

This role reports directly to the Chief Growth Officer, Chris, and works closely with Eric, the video editor, the thumbnail designer, to shape brand identity, content production, and distribution.

Responsibilities

Own the creative direction of YouTube packaging, including titles and thumbnails, partnering with Peak’s editor and designers to translate each content brief into the final published package.
Run the complete upload operation from beginning to end, including scheduling, descriptions, tags, chapters, end screens, cards, links, disclosures, and final quality-control review.
Run the complete operations of our clips channels
Run the complete operations of our livestreams
Ensure no video goes live without passing Peak’s complete editorial, technical, brand, and compliance checklist.
Build and operate a continuous A/B-testing framework for thumbnails and titles across new and catalogue videos, keeping packaging decisions defensible against channel benchmarks and documented test results.
Own YouTube analytics and build AI-agent-powered workflows for data compilation, anomaly detection, competitive research, reporting, and performance diagnosis.
Translate performance insights into specific decisions affecting video ideas, hooks, titles, thumbnails, scripting, production, and distribution.
Systematically audit and re-optimize Peak’s back catalogue, including thumbnails, titles, descriptions, calls to action, links, and metadata, and create a documented prioritization framework.
Track the compounding impression, view, subscriber, consultation, and revenue impact generated by back-catalogue optimization.
Monitor the retirement, investing, tax-planning, and personal-finance content landscape to identify rising viewer demand, competitive gaps, and differentiated opportunities for Peak.
Evaluate and roll out new YouTube features using a clear test-and-measure process.
Maintain a reliable connection between channel performance and downstream business outcomes, including website traffic, consultation-funnel activity, qualified booked calls, and new-client acquisition.
Work within Peak’s compliance requirements as an SEC-registered investment adviser, ensuring content, descriptions, claims, disclosures, and publishing workflows meet the firm’s standards.

Requirements

3+ years managing, growing, or optimizing a high-volume YouTube channel.
Deep command of YouTube’s packaging ecosystem, including thumbnails, titles, click-through-rate mechanics, retention patterns, traffic sources, recommendation behavior, and catalogue optimization.
Strong analytical fundamentals and demonstrated experience drawing practical creative decisions from performance data.
Demonstrated experience running and documenting A/B tests for YouTube content.
Familiarity with AI tools for analytics, reporting, research, or workflow automation—or a clear drive to build with them.
Proficiency with project-management tools and Google Workspace, plus strong written communication for titles, descriptions, creative briefs, and internal reports.
Strong quality-control instincts and the ability to manage detailed publishing workflows without missed steps or preventable errors.
Ability to distinguish between content that generates broad attention and content that attracts qualified prospective clients.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, fully remote environment with clear ownership and measurable accountability.
Experience with financial, retirement, investing, or educational media is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with the advertising and recordkeeping considerations affecting financial-services content is a plus.

Results

Click-through-rate and impression benchmarks improve consistently across new uploads.
New videos attract qualified retirement-planning viewers—not merely broad, low-intent traffic.
The back catalogue generates measurable new impression, view, subscriber, consultation, and revenue volume through systematic re-optimization.
A/B testing is continuous, documented, and actively informs packaging decisions.
Analytics reporting is automated, timely, decision-ready, and connected to downstream business performance.
Zero uploads go live without passing the complete editorial, technical, brand, and compliance checklist.
Subscriber growth trends upward quarter over quarter.
YouTube remains a measurable and growing driver of qualified website traffic, consultation calls, new clients, and revenue for Peak Financial Planning.
The channel develops a clearer and more defensible competitive position as a leading source of retirement-planning education.

We are looking for a highly skilled Circuit Design Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving electronic hardware, circuit simulation, programmatic EDA workflows, verification, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits. A representative task may require interpreting circuit requirements, producing or modifying a netlist or hardware description, running simulations or verification tools from the command line, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the design satisfies its electrical and functional constraints.

This role requires experience with real circuit designs that were fabricated, shipped, integrated, or taped out. Simulation-only academic experience is not sufficient. Candidates must also have experience with tools that support programmatic or command-line workflows.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Design, analyze, and validate analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits.
  2. Translate electrical requirements into schematics, netlists, models, HDL, constraints, or simulation inputs.
  3. Run circuit simulation, synthesis, verification, or related workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  4. Use Python to generate inputs, automate simulations, run parameter sweeps, control instruments, and analyze results.
  5. Evaluate voltage, current, power, gain, bandwidth, impedance, noise, timing, stability, thermal behavior, and other relevant outputs.
  6. Perform corner, tolerance, worst-case, transient, frequency-domain, or Monte Carlo analyses where appropriate.
  7. Compare simulated behavior with analytical calculations and physical measurements.
  8. Diagnose problems involving component selection, parasitics, layout, power integrity, signal integrity, thermal behavior, interfaces, or manufacturing.
  9. Review AI-generated circuit solutions and identify incorrect assumptions, invalid configurations, or unsupported conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and automated verification checks.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline; or
  2. A BS in Electrical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of relevant professional circuit-design experience.
  3. Meaningful experience designing analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits.
  4. Experience with designs that were fabricated, integrated, shipped, or taped out—not only simulated.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one EDA, circuit-simulation, PCB, HDL, synthesis, or verification tool that supports CLI, scripting, text-based inputs, or a programmatic API.
  7. Strong understanding of circuit behavior, component selection, tolerances, failure modes, and design trade-offs.
  8. Experience with hardware bring-up, laboratory validation, design verification, or post-fabrication debugging.
  9. Ability to explain circuit behavior and technical decisions clearly.

Relevant tools may include ngspice, Xyce, Yosys, Verilator, KiCad scripting, SPICE-compatible simulators, HDL simulators, synthesis tools, or equivalent programmatic EDA software. Experience with a comparable CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include PySpice, NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, cocotb, instrument-control libraries, EDA APIs, or internally developed automation tools. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

We are seeking an experienced Software QA & Testing Engineer to join our dynamic team. You will lead the testing efforts to identify and resolve issues, optimize performance, ensure cross-browser compatibility, and verify the scalability and resiliency of software capabilities under load.

As part of our commitment to innovation, your role will involve implementing AI-powered testing methodologies to improve coverage and identify issues proactively. If you have hands-on experience with automation, cross-browser testing, performance testing, and industry-leading tools (including AI-based solutions), this is the perfect opportunity for your career growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Test Planning & Strategy

  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define test objectives.
  • Develop and document comprehensive and efficient test plans, strategies, and exit criteria.
  • Ensure alignment with Agile frameworks for CI/CD processes to maintain quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle.

2. Manual Testing

  • Perform detailed manual testing on new features, functional flows, and regression cases.
  • Conduct comprehensive exploratory testing for edge-case scenarios to uncover potential issues early.
  • Ensure test data coverage for all features, workflows, integrations, and edge cases.

3. Automation Testing

  • Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks for both web and mobile applications using leading tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, and/or similar.
  • Write efficient and reusable automated test scripts to conduct functional and end-to-end testing.
  • Work on integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline).

4. Cross-Browser & Device Testing

  • Perform cross-browser testing on modern browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge using tools like BrowserStack, Lambdatest, or CrossBrowserTesting.
  • Validate software compatibility across various operating systems and devices (desktop and mobile).

5. Performance Testing

  • Design and execute performance, scalability, and stress tests for high-traffic systems using tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
  • Monitor application response time, throughput, and behavior under heavy load scenarios.
  • Analyze performance bottlenecks and provide optimization recommendations to development teams.

6. AI-Driven Testing

  • Utilize AI-powered test case generation tools like Testim, Applitools, or Tricentis Tosca to design smarter and faster test cases.
  • Work with AI-based tools for visual regression testing and intelligent defect identification.
  • Stay up to date on emerging trends in AI-driven QA solutions to enhance testing strategies.

7. Defect Reporting & Debugging

  • Identify, document, and track bugs and defects found during testing using bug-tracking tools such as JIRA, Trello, and Azure DevOps.
  • Actively collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve defects, ensuring software efficiency and stability.

8. Documentation & Reporting

  • Create and maintain a repository of detailed test plans, test cases, and test execution reports.
  • Generate test metrics and quality reports to update stakeholders regarding system quality and testing progress.

Requirements

1. Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4–6 years of experience in a Software QA role, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality software products.

2. Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with manual and automation testing of workflows and UI components.
  • Proficiency with key automation testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, Playwright, Cypress, etc.).
  • Demonstrated expertise in cross-browser testing tools (e.g., BrowserStack, LambdaTest, Sauce Labs).
  • Advanced knowledge of performance and stress testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling, or k6).
  • Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, or Karate.
  • Proficiency with test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail) and version control systems like Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines).

3. AI Testing Tools

  • Hands-on experience with AI-enhanced testing tools such as:
    • Testim, Tricentis Tosca, Katalon AI, Applitools, and Mabl
    • AI-powered visual testing and smart test case generation
  • Understanding of AI-driven methodologies for predictive testing, defect prioritization, and anomaly detection.

4. Additional Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills with an eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex issues to technical and business stakeholders clearly.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT VICTORY LIVE Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory.
jobs.description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer to build and maintain features across our Ruby on Rails and Hanami services. You'll own well-scoped pieces of our B2B marketplace and ticketing platform end to end, from design through production, working closely with senior engineers who'll help you level up.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ship features. Build and maintain services in Rails and Hanami, from a scoped design through code review to production.
  • Write tests that hold. Cover your code with RSpec so regressions show up in CI, not in production.
  • Debug production issues. Use logs, metrics, and Rails console access to trace bugs to root cause.
  • Work within our data layer. Write efficient ActiveRecord queries and migrations that don't lock production tables.
  • Handle background work. Build and monitor Sidekiq jobs for async processing.
  • Take code review seriously. Review teammates' PRs and act on the feedback you get on your own.
  • Use AI tooling daily. Pair with Claude Code and Copilot for scaffolding, tests, and debugging, and learn where to trust them and where not to.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2–4 years building production software, with at least 1–2 years in Ruby on Rails.
  • Comfortable writing and debugging ActiveRecord queries, migrations, and background jobs.
  • Solid grasp of RSpec and test-driven development.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs and relational databases.
  • Growing but genuine use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exposure to Hanami or another Ruby framework beyond Rails.
  • Familiarity with Sidekiq, Redis, or Kafka.
  • Interest in ticketing, marketplaces, or high-transaction consumer platforms.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.
  • Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure.
  • Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration.

OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING

  • Ruby on Rails and Hanami power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs
  • Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frameworks and tools: Rails, Hanami, Sidekiq, Puma, ActiveRecord, RSpec, RuboCop
  • Data: Postgres, Redis, Kafka
  • Cloud & infra: AWS (RDS, ElastiCache, CloudSearch, EKS, MSK), Kubernetes, Helm, Kong, Terraform, Docker
  • AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows
  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro
  • Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee wellness and professional development opportunities

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate findings and recommend practical remediation strategies

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

  • Participants build foundational skills in group facilitation, public speaking and advocacy through comprehensive training on how to facilitate vital conversations about mental health with their peers in a safe and supportive way.
  • Facilitators receive $250 for completing training and certifying as a Jack Talks for Indigenous Youth Facilitator, and are compensated $50 for each Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth they facilitate, in addition to $50 for the preparation of each talk.
    The time commitment for this program is approximately 2-5 hours a month between September and June, and approximately 4 hours for combined asynchronous and synchronous training once a term.

What is the Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth? Check out this video

The Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth puts community practice front and centre in educating about mental health struggle and healing from Indigenous perspectives. The program uses contact-based education and peer-to-peer outreach to connect Indigenous youth across Canada in conversations about mental health and healing.

A Jack Talk for Indigenous Youth is made up of two parts:

  • a video portion that explains social determinants of mental health from Indigenous perspectives and features youth stories about navigating mental health struggle, experiences with stigma and the relationship between culture, community and mental health
  • a live sharing circle led by an Indigenous Youth Facilitator who guides participants in exploring lessons and reflections, using the video portion as the spark for generating group discussion and connection.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Position Summary

The Scrum Master supports agile project execution, coaches team members, and promotes continuous process improvement within Magpie. The Scrum Master facilitates sprint cross-functional initiatives while promoting accountability and transparency. The position tracks and analyzes workflow and team performance metrics and drives efficient workplans to increase product delivery that align with project objectives.

The Scrum Master combines strong facilitation and leadership skills with practical business acumen. The individual must understand how the organization creates value, how team deliverables support business goals, and how customer needs, risk, quality, compliance, and operational constraints affect priorities and decisions. Success requires the ability to work effectively with varied personalities, communication styles, disciplines, and levels of authority. The Scrum Master must be comfortable facilitating difficult conversations, constructively challenging assumptions, addressing counterproductive behaviors, and helping teams resolve disagreements without assuming managerial authority.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities

Scrum Facilitation

  • Facilitate Scrum/Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, spikes, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives) and ensure ceremonies are purposeful and efficient.
  • Coach and mentor product owners, teammates, and stakeholders on agile or Scrum principles
  • Partner with the Product Owner to support backlog readiness, prioritization, and acceptance criteria with business goals.
  • Protect the team from unplanned work, unclear priorities, avoidable interruptions, and commitments made without appropriate team input.
  • Track and report key agile metrics (velocity, burn-down/up charts, cycle time, throughput) and analyze team performance trends to identify opportunities for improving delivery and predictability.
  • Identify and remove obstacles or engage the appropriate owner when resolution is outside the team’s authority.
  • Identify process gaps, impediments, and bottlenecks; coordinate with team members, product owners, and stakeholders to remove blockers and implement workflow refinements.
  • Continuously gather feedback, capture lessons learned from retrospectives, and drive process improvements.
  • Monitor team capacity, help plan releases, and assist in coordinating demos, stakeholder reviews, user acceptance testing, and deployment activities.

Communication and Leadership

  • Deliver difficult or unfavorable information without avoiding, minimizing, or unnecessarily escalating the issue.
  • Adjust communication methods to suit different audiences, working styles, technical backgrounds, and levels of seniority.
  • Recognize when coaching or facilitation is sufficient and when escalation is necessary.
  • Foster an environment in which team members can raise risks, mistakes, concerns, questions, and dissenting views without fear of reprisal.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Provide accurate, concise, and candid project reporting to sponsors, stakeholders, and governance bodies.
  • Facilitate candid discussions regarding missed commitments, unclear ownership, recurring impediments, and process breakdowns.

Business Acumen

  • Develop a working understanding of the organization’s mission, strategy, products, services, customers, operating model, and competitive environment.
  • Help team connect sprint goals and backlog items to defined product outcomes and business objectives.
  • Understand key business performance measures and help the team evaluate whether completed work produces the intended outcome.
  • Consider downstream impacts on operations, customer support, training, reporting, security, compliance, and other affected functions.
  • Use business knowledge to improve facilitation and decision support while respecting the Product Owner’s authority over product priorities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience supporting CMS, HHS, DoD or other federal/state health programs.
  • Experience supporting product development, process improvement, organizational change, or compliance-related initiatives.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or other agile certification preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience using agile tools such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or comparable platforms.

ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to own the technologies and processes that power our B2B marketplace on C# and .NET. You'll ship features across several business-critical services, retire technical debt, and set the standards other engineers build against. This is a chance to shape one of our main revenue engines at a premier live event ticketing company.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate across teams to influence engineering work, ensuring decisions align with divisional strategy.
  • Drive large-scale technical initiatives in our .NET services, solving highly complex problems and shipping scalable, secure solutions.
  • Provide guidance and support to engineers, helping them grow and work through hard technical problems.
  • Work with Architects to design and implement system-level solutions within company standards.
  • Define and promote engineering best practices across teams, from test coverage to service boundaries.
  • Identify and pay down technical debt to keep our .NET services maintainable.
  • Hold the team's code to a high bar through rigorous review, consistent with our quality program.
  • Write high-quality code yourself on the most complex and critical work.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining high-throughput backend services and APIs at scale.
  • Deep understanding of software engineering best practices.
  • Familiarity with the rest of our stack: Entity Framework Core, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis, MSSQL Server, Datadog, Grafana, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker, GitHub.
  • Familiarity with Azure and AWS services.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Knowledge of live ticket sales or experience working within a fast-paced industry.
  • Mentorship and leadership experience guiding onshore and offshore teams.
  • Genuine interest in growing the engineers around you and shaping team culture, even without a formal management track.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.
  • Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure.
  • Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration.

OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING

  • C# and .NET power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs
  • Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frameworks and tools: .NET, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, xUnit
  • Data: MSSQL Server, Postgres, Redis
  • Cloud & infra: Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows
  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro
  • Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee wellness and professional development opportunities

jobs.excerpt: We have begun preparing for the interview process for this position and are only reviewing new candidates at the hiring manager's discretion.
jobs.description:
We have begun preparing for the interview process for this position and are only reviewing new candidates at the hiring manager's discretion.

Job Summary

Sports Reference, LLC is searching for a Scrum Master to assist our Agile teams by facilitating and coordinating Agile processes within the engineering department and cross-functional teams. The engineering team currently has 22 team members consisting of developers, testers, DevOps, and Scrum Masters.

We currently serve 20 million (and growing) monthly users on our free, ad-supported Reference Sites (, , , etc.) and , our SaaS offering that provides powerful search and filtering capabilities for deeper exploration of our vast databases. In 2023, we acquired , the viral baseball trivia game, and have since launched ad-supported grid games for basketball, football, hockey, and soccer.

To Apply

Please visit our jobs website at and submit your resume and a cover letter for this position.

We plan to begin the phone interview process the week of August 31st, but may start earlier depending on the volume of applications we receive. Applications arriving after phone interviews begin will be collected, but will receive consideration at the discretion of the hiring manager based on the progress we have made in filling the position. We have provided a general outline of our interview process here:

Our Purpose and Values

We democratize data, so our users enjoy, understand, and share the sports they love.

We value:

  • Respect for our users, the athletes we cover, and our team;
  • Craftsmanship in building tools and products;
  • Reliable tools and services that meet our users' needs every day; and
  • Data democratization. We publish many data sets for emerging and underserved sports. The New York Times covered our recognition of the Negro Leagues as major leagues in the summer of 2021. We added women’s college basketball data to our site in 2023 and now have the only publicly available database of every score in women’s NCAA Division 1 history.

More on our values and history can be found on our about page. To meet these expectations, we encourage team members to participate in company discussions and share new ideas, features or potential solutions to problems.

Background

As a Scrum Master, you will facilitate and coordinate Agile processes within cross-functional teams, ensuring the team can work collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality solutions.

You will work closely with the team to ensure that the work progresses on schedule and to the desired level of quality. Additionally, you will help to foster a culture of continuous improvement and ensuring that the team is meeting its objectives consistently.

This is an entry level position, and Sports Reference will work with you to train your skills on the specifics of the role. This is a position within our engineering department, but no development skills are required.

We are searching for the role of a scrum master, but do not expect Scrum certification for this role. We provide continuing education benefits and would support you earning your Scrum certification.

Goals and Tasks for Your First Year (In rough order of importance)

Must-Reach Goals and Tasks

  • Organize project work in dashboards and project management tooling, and keep the status up to date
  • Help coordinate small to medium sized projects within the company
  • Report status of projects regularly verbally in small meetings, as well as written asynchronous communication when needed
  • Help create small tasks in project management software and assign as appropriate
  • Facilitate meetings (standups, iteration boundary, retros) ranging from 3-45+ people
  • Keep metrics about the status of work that is currently being worked on
  • Continually improve our process by analysis and holding retrospective meetings

Nice-to-Reach Goals and Tasks

  • Manage issues, small features and defects for teams
  • Facilitate demos of completed issues and requests
  • Help understand resourcing constraints for upcoming projects and suggest potential candidates based on skills within the engineering team

Qualifications and Skills

A qualified candidate will satisfy the following:

  • Evidence that you are capable of meeting many of the goals listed above.
  • Have a history of getting things done (and done well).
  • If you don’t think your application will have evidence that you can meet all of the 'nice-to-reach goals and tasks' above but still are interested in the job and otherwise qualify, please apply. Nobody checks every box—we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

Salary

Our salary range starts at $84k for U.S. based employees. We are a remote-first company and determine our pay range for this position based on the market rates for Philadelphia, our home base. The salary offered will be based on your experience and skill level.

Annual bonuses are variable and are tied to a percentage of the company's end of year profits and the employee's time worked and salary earned during the year. In the last three years, they have averaged 15% of an employee’s annual salary.

Benefits

Even though we are a small company, Sports Reference has a generous benefits package.

  • The total value of our benefits package is up to $30,000.
  • We cover full health and dental insurance costs for full-time employees and their dependent children. We cover 70%-80% of plans for an entire family.
  • We have a 401k with a match on your contributions up to 4% of your base salary. The 401k has many low cost investing options.
  • We pay all premiums for company-sponsored life and long-term disability insurance for all employees.
  • We provide up to $7,000/year in continuing education benefits.
  • Even if you live in or near Philly, you have the option to work remotely as much as you choose. We generally work a standard workday, but with flexibility to adjust hours within that framework.
  • Any parent welcoming a new child to their family is entitled to 13 weeks of fully paid leave, and up to an additional 39 weeks at half-time.
  • Employees begin with 18 days of PTO per year and an additional 8 paid company holidays and accrue sick leave at the rate of one day per month.
  • We will generally buy you whatever equipment will make you the most productive.
  • We typically will pay for reasonable moving-related expenses related to your acceptance of a position with Sports Reference. Please ask if you have questions regarding this benefit.
  • We provide a $68/month remote work stipend to cover the cost of internet access and incidental expenses.

Other Information

  • Sports Reference's first site was launched in 2000. We have bootstrapped ourselves to 45 full-time employees and have no venture capital backing.
  • Applicants must have a legal right to work in the United States or Canada. Hiring an employee not based in the US or Canada would be difficult to coordinate at this time.
  • We are willing to provide accommodations for candidates for whom the timing or structure of our interview process may be challenging. This may include early morning or evening interview times or provide payment to cover child care expenses if needed. If you are applying for a role where verbal communication is not a significant requirement, we may consider an alternative form of interview as is reasonably possible and suitable. Similarly, if an extended period of internet connectivity is a challenge, we may consider an alternate form of interview. If we invite you to interview, please let us know of any possibly necessary accommodations.
  • Our typical interview process is described at
  • Sports Reference is a remote-first company. Sports Reference is located in Philadelphia and non-Philadelphia candidates will be considered on an equal footing to those who are local. Presently, all Sports Reference employees are working remotely at least some of the time, but those in the Philly area may work from the office on days of their choosing.
  • This is a full-time position.
  • Employment at Sports Reference LLC is at-will and this position is an at-will appointment.
  • 100% of our merchandise sales support youth sports.

Sports Reference is a growing company, and your work will be highly visible and have a definite and immediate impact (Read about us in the New York Times and The Athletic ($)). We reached over 20 million users each month and served over 2.0 billion pages in 2023.

jobs.description:
ABOUT VICTORY LIVE
Victory Live is a private equity backed technology company aimed at maximizing distribution and yield for live event ticket inventory. We provide an end-to-end software platform for the live ticketing industry, managing thousands of sports, theater, and live music event tickets on behalf of artists, promoters, teams, venues, and professional resellers. Victory Live’s comprehensive offerings include an established B2B marketplace, along with both a full-service and an automated SaaS platform to handle all elements of the ticket sales lifecycle, from ingestion to sales fulfillment.

THE POSITION
Victory Live is looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer to build and maintain features across our Python and FastAPI services. You'll own well-scoped pieces of our B2B marketplace and ticketing platform end to end, from design through production, working closely with senior engineers who'll help you level up.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ship features. Build and maintain services in FastAPI, from a scoped design through code review to production.
  • Write tests that hold. Cover your code with pytest so regressions show up in CI, not in production.
  • Debug production issues. Use logs, metrics, and Datadog dashboards to trace bugs to root cause.
  • Work within our data layer. Write efficient SQLAlchemy queries and Alembic migrations that don't lock production tables.
  • Handle background and async work. Build and monitor Celery tasks and async FastAPI endpoints.
  • Take code review seriously. Review teammates' PRs and act on the feedback you get on your own.
  • Use AI tooling daily. Pair with Claude Code and Copilot for scaffolding, tests, and debugging, and learn where to trust them and where not to.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 2–4 years building production software, with at least 1–2 years in Python.
  • Comfortable building REST APIs with FastAPI and validating data with Pydantic.
  • Solid grasp of pytest and test-driven development.
  • Working knowledge of SQLAlchemy, relational databases, and database migrations.
  • Growing but genuine use of AI tooling in your day-to-day workflow.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exposure to Celery, asyncio, or other async Python patterns.
  • Familiarity with Redis or Kafka.
  • Interest in ticketing, marketplaces, or high-transaction consumer platforms.

WHY VICTORY LIVE

  • You'll build the infrastructure live events run on; millions of tickets, hundreds of venues, many of the largest teams and events in the world.
  • A lean team where decisions move fast and your code reaches real fans, often the same week.
  • Every release has stakes. Every improvement is felt.
  • High expectations, low tolerance for politics, and a culture built on writing well and shipping with care.

OUR VALUES
We build the systems that power live event ticketing, and we hold a high bar for how we do it. Four principles run through everything:

  • Quality of life. Sustainable processes over heroics. Nobody should be a single point of failure, and nobody should be afraid to take a vacation.
  • Quality of code. Clarity over cleverness. If a teammate needs a long explanation to follow your code, it needs simplifying. Tests prove your work; they aren't optional.
  • Protection of production. Every change is reviewed, tested, and observable. We build with monitoring in mind from day one so we find problems before our users do.
  • Shared knowledge. We work across time zones, so we communicate in the open. Questions go in channels, not DMs, and one answer becomes shared knowledge.

ENGINEERING PRINCIPLES
We are an AI-native engineering team. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • AI-assisted engineering. Every engineer uses Claude, Claude Code, Copilot, and agentic tooling as a routine part of their workflow.
  • Async-first. Most decisions happen in writing through Jira, Confluence, PR descriptions, design docs. We over-communicate on changes and under-communicate on noise.
  • Ownership mindset. Engineers are responsible for what they write and no code reaches production without review. Reviewers are co-owners.
  • Observability is part of "done." If the on-call engineer can't understand a system without reading source, more logging, metrics, and dashboards are needed.
  • Preservation of quality of code and life. We write code that is clean, tested, and maintainable so it serves us well over time, and we build sustainable processes so no one burns out or becomes a single point of failure.
  • Shared knowledge and continued education. We grow as a team by learning from each other through reviews, documentation, and collaboration.

OUR STACK & WAYS OF WORKING

  • Python and FastAPI power our B2B marketplace, distribution integrations, and partner-facing APIs
  • Web & mobile clients, REST APIs, microservices
  • Frameworks and tools: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Celery, pytest, Uvicorn
  • Data: Postgres, Redis, Kafka
  • Cloud & infra: AWS (RDS, ElastiCache, CloudSearch, EKS, MSK), Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker
  • AI tooling: Anthropic / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, in-house agentic workflows
  • Observability: Datadog, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana, OpsGenie
  • Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Slack, Miro
  • Async-first, agile cadences, distributed onshore + offshore teams

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • 100% employer-paid dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee wellness and professional development opportunities

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or another other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law.

Junior Software Engineer

Remote | US

About Climavision  

At Climavision, we’re rebuilding climate technology from the ground up and changing the way we see weather. We merge the power of our proprietary, high-resolution weather radar and satellite network with advanced weather prediction modelling and decades of industry expertise to reduce existing coverage gaps and drastically improve forecasting ability. Our revolutionary new approach to and climate solutions is poised to help reduce the economic risks of climate change on companies, governments, and societies alike. We are backed by The Rise Fund, the world’s largest global impact platform committed to achieving measurable, positive social and environmental outcomes alongside competitive financial returns. Climavision is headquartered in Louisville, KY, with research and development operations in Raleigh, NC.

The Work  

As a Junior Software Engineer at Climavision, you will work across the full stack — building and operating both the backend services and APIs that move weather data from our observation network and forecast models to the customers and applications that depend on it, and the web interfaces that make that data usable across the company. This role is designed for someone early in their career and will start with well-scoped features and bug fixes inside existing services and interfaces, working closely with senior engineers through code review, and growing towards owning larger pieces of the platform. You’ll be working closely with a team of senior and staff-level engineers who are genuinely invested in developing junior talent — this role is built to grow you quickly, not just fill a seat. We care far more about how you think, how you test, and how clearly you communicate than about the number of years on your résumé.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Implement well-scoped features, API endpoints, bug fixes, and user-facing interfaces across our backend services and web front end, following the patterns and conventions already established in the codebase.
  • Write automated tests — both fast unit tests and integration tests that exercise real dependencies — and reproduce bugs with a failing test before you fix them.
  • Participate actively in code review, first as an author and over time as a reviewer. Expect thorough, constructive review of your work from your first pull request.
  • Work with relational databases: write queries, model data, and author schema migrations.
  • Add and improve instrumentation — structured logging, metrics, health checks, and traces — so that problems in production are diagnosable rather than mysterious.
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex as part of your everyday development loop, and help improve the shared rules, skills, and agent configurations we keep in source control alongside the code.
  • Build and extend the Blazor web interfaces and dashboards that make platform behavior visible and usable across the company.
  • Help operate what you build, working with containers, deployment pipelines, and Kubernetes configuration with support from the team.
  • Write clear pull request descriptions, add comments that explain the reasoning behind your code when helpful, and keep relevant documentation up to date as changes are made.

Qualifications

  • Up to 2 years of professional software engineering experience. Recent graduates, bootcamp graduates, and career changers with strong technical fundamentals are encouraged to apply.
  • A degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience through internships, personal projects, open-source contributions, or work in an adjacent technical discipline.
  • Working knowledge of at least one modern programming language (C#, Java, Python, Go, or C++), with an interest in working primarily in C# and .NET. This is a full-stack role; prior front-end or Blazor experience is not required, but a willingness to learn is.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational database fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Git and a pull-request-based workflow in GitHub.
  • Interest in working with AI coding tools, including Claude and Codex, which are integrated into the teams day-to-day workflows.
  • Ability to break problems into manageable pieces, asks thoughtful questions, and communicates when you are stuck or need additional context.
  • Strong written communication. As a distributed team, much of our collaboration happens asynchronous and in writing.
  • Curiosity about the systems surrounding your code, including where data comes from, where it goes, and how systems respond when something does not behave as expected.

Nice to have, but not required:

  • Exposure to C# and .NET, particularly ASP.NET Core.
  • Experience building Claude Code extensions or plugins, such as skills, subagents, hooks, slash commands, or MCP servers.
  • Exposure to automated testing using a framework such as xUnit, including integration testing against real dependencies such as Testcontainers.
  • Familiarity with Docker and basic exposure to Kubernetes concepts, such as manifests, logs, and readiness probes.
  • Exposure to a public cloud platform, ideally Azure (Blob Storage, Service Bus, Event Grid).
  • Exposure to message-driven or event-driven systems, such as queues, pub/sub, MQTT, or streams.
  • Familiarity with distributed software systems and concepts such as retries, partial failures, and eventual consistency.
  • Exposure to a component-based web UI framework such as Blazor, React, Vue, or Angular.
  • Exposure to observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.
  • Familiarity with Python, particularly for data processing or small services.
  • Exposure to CI/CD concepts and tools, such as GitHub Actions.
  • Experience working in a start-up or other fast-moving environment is a plus.

Physical Demands & Work Environment:  

  • This is a full-time, exempt position
  • Fully Remote - United States  
  • This job requires frequent use of a computer to complete tasks, attend meetings, and communicate via Microsoft Teams. 

Once you land this position, you’ll get to enjoy:  

  • Benefits of a dynamic and growing organization  
  • A challenging, hands-on role that will have real impact on the business  
  • Competitive compensation 
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • 401(k) Savings Plan 
  • Medical/Dental/Vision Benefits 
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Unlimited Paid Time-off 
  • 11 Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental Leave 
  • Company Paid Short-term Disability (STD)
  • Company Paid Long-term Disability (LTD)
  • Company Paid Life Insurance  

The salary range for this position is $75,000-90,000 annually, however Climavision considers several factors when extending an offer of employment including but not limited to, the applicant’s education, experience, the responsibilities of the role, training, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Any offer of employment is contingent on completion of a background check to company standard. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Climavision is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law. Role Title: CFD Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging CFD Engineers to contribute to a project focused on advancing the capabilities of AI technologies within engineering simulation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity enables you to impact the future of engineering by ensuring that AI systems can accurately interpret, solve, and explain complex computational fluid dynamics challenges across mesh generation, turbulence modeling, multiphase and heat-transfer simulation, solver setup, and verification & validation. Contributors who value accuracy, technical depth, and clear communication—both written and verbal—will find this engagement uniquely rewarding and influential.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate and solve advanced CFD challenges involving mesh generation, turbulence modeling, multiphase flow, heat transfer, and solver configuration.
  2. Review and assess AI-generated technical responses for correctness, accuracy, and engineering integrity.
  3. Apply practical engineering judgment to simulation scenarios and theoretical fluid-dynamics questions.
  4. Analyze and troubleshoot CFD problems using best practices such as mesh independence, turbulence model selection, boundary-condition specification, and convergence analysis.
  5. Contribute domain expertise to refine and inform the reasoning capabilities of AI in computational fluid dynamics.
  6. Document feedback and provide clear written and verbal explanations that enhance AI learning and performance.
  7. Collaborate remotely within a distributed network of technical experts and project participants.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on fluid dynamics or thermofluids; or equivalent practical experience (3+ years) in CFD.
  2. At least 3 years of hands-on experience conducting and validating CFD simulations, including mesh generation, solver setup, turbulence modeling, multiphase/heat-transfer analysis, or post-processing in industries such as aerospace, automotive, energy, marine, HVAC, process, or biomedical.
  3. Deep understanding of Navier-Stokes equations, turbulence modeling (RANS, LES, DES), meshing strategies, boundary-condition specification, and verification & validation practices.
  4. Proven ability to analyze and validate fluid flow, heat-transfer, and multiphysics problems using CFD tools, cross-referencing with experimental or analytical data.
  5. Familiarity with relevant standards and practices (e.g., ASME V&V 20, AIAA CFD verification & validation, ITTC procedures).
  6. Excellent English proficiency with outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  7. Experience with CFD software (such as ANSYS Fluent, STAR-CCM+, OpenFOAM, COMSOL, or Converge) is a strong plus, as is a documented history of problem-authoring, technical committee service, competition leadership, or peer-recognized contributions in the CFD community.

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert's experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.
