jobs.excerpt: Materials Science ExpertPay: $80–$130/hour Location: Global, fully remote Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week) Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.
jobs.description:
Materials Science Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Materials Science Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational materials science, materials modeling, scientific simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to material structures, properties, processing, performance, and failure. A representative task may require constructing a material or atomic model, configuring and running a simulation, calculating relevant properties, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the solution is computationally valid and physically meaningful.

This role requires both strong materials expertise and experience using engineering or scientific tools programmatically. Experience limited exclusively to graphical user interfaces will not be sufficient, as task solutions must be reproducible through code, scripts, configuration files, or command-line tools.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate computational materials-science and materials-engineering problems.
  2. Create material structures, atomic configurations, compositions, and solver-ready inputs.
  3. Model relationships between composition, structure, processing, properties, and performance.
  4. Run atomistic, electronic-structure, molecular-dynamics, continuum, electrochemical, or related simulations.
  5. Use Python to generate inputs, automate calculations, conduct parameter sweeps, process results, and validate outputs.
  6. Analyze mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical, structural, or electrochemical properties.
  7. Diagnose failed calculations, invalid structures, convergence problems, numerical instability, and incorrect physical assumptions.
  8. Compare computational results with experimental data, literature values, known properties, or expected physical trends.
  9. Review AI-generated solutions for scientific correctness and identify invalid assumptions, configurations, or conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and objective verification methods.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Materials Science and Engineering, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline; or
  2. An MS or PhD in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering with a substantial materials specialization.
  3. Strong understanding of materials behavior and relevant structure-property relationships.
  4. Experience with computational materials modeling, simulation, characterization, or materials-focused engineering analysis.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering or scientific tool that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to understand and justify modeling assumptions, parameters, approximations, and convergence criteria.
  8. Ability to distinguish computational failures from genuine physical behavior.
  9. Ability to explain complex scientific reasoning and technical limitations clearly.

Relevant tools may include LAMMPS, ASE, pymatgen, Quantum ESPRESSO, FEniCSx, CalculiX, Elmer, PyBaMM, or similar programmatic materials and simulation software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, atomistic modeling packages, materials informatics libraries, or domain-specific scientific tools. No single library is mandatory.

Experience may come from academic research, national laboratories, industry R&D, computational engineering, or other demonstrated materials work.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.description:
Part-time: 20-30 hours per month

Details: Competitive hourly rate (Senior, Fractional). Long-term engagement if mutually successful

Job ID: 26FRA301

Fractional Product Systems Designer (Web + iOS) - Remote (U.S.- based)

Overview

Serious Development builds internal business applications at speed using: v0 for prototyping, Angular + PrimeNG for implementation, Native iOS apps that feel like iOS, not web-on-a-phone. We are seeking a Fractional Product Systems Designer (Web + iOS) to design how our products behave over time.

Why This Role Exists

We build internal business applications at speed using:

  • v0 for prototyping
  • Angular + PrimeNG for implementation
  • Native iOS apps that must feel like iOS, not web-on-a-phone

As our velocity increased, traditional screen-based design became unnecessary. What did become necessary is system-level UX ownership.

This role exists to ensure our products remain:

  • Predictable
  • Consistent
  • Native to their platforms
  • Easy to learn and hard to misuse

You will not be designing every screen. You will be designing how the product behaves over time.

Who You Are

Required

  • Senior-level product or systems designer
  • Experience with internal or enterprise applications
  • Strong systems thinking; comfortable defining rules and constraints
  • Deep familiarity with iOS as a platform (not just mobile UI)
  • Comfortable challenging PMs and saying “don’t ship that”
  • Pragmatic, opinionated, and not precious about visuals

Strong Plus

  • Experience cleaning up inconsistent products
  • Familiarity with component-based design systems
  • Experience working with engineers directly
  • Prior fractional or advisory roles

Red Flags (for us)

  • Portfolio-first, system-light background
  • Strong preference for redesigns over convergence
  • Focus on “delight” over clarity and predictability
  • Reliance on Figma as the primary output

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Product-wide UX coherence

  • Own interaction patterns across the product
  • Ensure similar problems are solved the same way
  • Reduce inconsistency as new modules are added
  • Prevent UX drift as multiple PMs and teams ship in parallel

Working within existing products

  • Audit current applications and patterns
  • Identify what already works and should be preserved
  • Drive convergence — not redesign-for-the-sake-of-redesign
  • Respect user muscle memory

Web UX (Angular + PrimeNG)

  • Define how PrimeNG components are used (tables, forms, filters, modals)
  • Establish behavioral standards:
  • States
  • Errors
  • Permissions
  • Progressive disclosure
  • Prevent “almost-the-same” component variants

iOS UX (Native-first)

  • Ensure strict alignment with Apple Human Interface Guidelines
  • Catch web/Android patterns leaking into iOS
  • Enforce native navigation, gestures, and control usage
  • Prioritize platform correctness over internal consistency when they conflict

Partnering with PMs

  • Review v0 prototypes and early implementations
  • Provide fast, opinionated feedback
  • Help PMs reason through UX tradeoffs
  • Establish clear guardrails PMs can confidently operate within

What You Will Not Be Doing

  • Pixel-perfect mock production
  • Designing every feature or screen
  • Maintaining Figma parity with code
  • Visual branding or marketing design
  • Creating handoff artifacts for engineers
  • If your default output is screens, this is not the right role.

What Success Looks Like

  • UX feels consistent across modules and platforms
  • PMs move fast without inventing new patterns
  • Fewer usability questions from users
  • Faster onboarding with less training
  • No “why does this work differently over here?” moments
  • No large-scale UX rewrites six months later

How You’ll Work

  • Review-heavy, not production-heavy
  • Embedded early in feature thinking, not late-stage polish
  • Prefer rules, patterns, and written guidance over visuals
  • Use Figma only when a concept cannot be expressed clearly in text or prototypes
  • Code and prototypes are the source of truth.

jobs.excerpt: About the PositionMeridian University is currently hiring multiple adjunct faculty to teach graduate courses in Clinical Psychology.
jobs.description:
About the Position

Meridian University is currently hiring multiple adjunct faculty to teach graduate courses in Clinical Psychology.

These roles are fully remote -- applications across the US and internationally are welcome.

Master's and Doctoral degrees in Psychology at Meridian provide a cumulative, emergent, and integrated curriculum, empowering the student’s transformation both personally and professionally.

The Psychology program integrates a number of diverse orientations including Integral Psychology, Somatic and Yoga Psychology, Depth Psychology, Transpersonal Psychology, and Clinical Psychology. Learning outcomes include collaborativity, law and ethics, process skills, psychopathology, reflexivity, empathy, and culture.

Psychology at Meridian integrates three distinct dimensions of Psychology: academic discipline, vocation and profession. Psychology at Meridian seeks to reclaim the soul through the imagination, and draws on numerous knowledge domains which are not a recognized part of the conventional discipline and profession of psychology.

About Meridian

Founded 30 years ago in the San Francisco Bay Area, Meridian University enrolls students globally in its unique hybrid and 100% online graduate degree, certificate, and public programs. The University offers master's and doctoral programs in Psychology, Education and Business with diverse concentrations available within each of these programs. Meridian’s integrated, innovative curriculum is designed to be experiential and transformative.

Meridian graduates are engaged in varied professional contexts that include coaching, psychotherapy, organizational development, facilitation, social healing, social entrepreneurship, and transformative leadership.

Meridian’s graduate programs are available in two formats, hybrid and 100% online. This model supports students who are working professionals and balancing other life commitments to move forward towards their personal and professional future.

Meridian is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission and approved by the US Department of Education for participation in the Federal Student Aid program. WASC is the Department of Education-recognized regional accreditor for such schools as the University of California at Berkeley, UCLA, and Stanford University. Meridian’s licensable degrees have been recognized by the California Board of Behavioral Sciences and Board of Psychology for over 25 years.

Qualifications

  • PsyD or PhD in Psychology from an accredited institution
  • Prior teaching experience
  • Experience with online teaching in Blackboard, Canvas, D2L, or Moodle
  • Experienced with a variety of cloud-based platforms like Microsoft Office 365
  • Consistently inspired to achieve and grow your contribution
  • Committed to life-long learning and personal responsibility
  • Excited by team collaboration and complex challenges
  • Live courses at Meridian are scheduled between the hours of 8am and 12pm PT. Availability within these hours is necessary for faculty to receive course assignments.

How to Apply

A cover letter and resume are required. In your cover letter, speak to your alignment with Meridian’s vision and mission as well as your skills and capacities relevant to the role description and qualifications.

Each application is reviewed thoroughly by multiple teams and faculty are hired on an as-needed basis. Therefore, timelines for applicant review, interviewing, and course assignment are unpredictable. We cannot respond to all applications due to the volume received.

Please do not call, email, or drop-in regarding your application.

Meridian is committed to diversity across all criteria-of-difference in its staff, faculty, and students. Meridian does not consider race, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status in hiring or admissions decisions.

MelodyArc delivers consistent outcomes for the work AI can't do alone — orchestrating data, rules, AI, and people in one governed system, with a full record of why. Role Overview

As an SDE 3, you'll be a senior, hands-on engineer and technical leader who ships business-critical capabilities on tight timelines. You will own the design and delivery of multi-component features, raise the bar on reliability and security, and help scale the team alongside the CTO through code reviews, mentoring, and pragmatic process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, and operate scalable backend services (NodeJS/TypeScript) that power MelodyArc's orchestration and workflow capabilities.

  • Review designs and code for peers; mentor engineers; and improve shared standards (testing, code quality, CI/CD, documentation).

  • Drive system design for reliability, performance, and scalability (e.g., idempotency, retries, rate-limiting, multi-tenant isolation, graceful degradation).

  • Partner closely with Product, DevOps, and customer stakeholders to iterate quickly and deliver measurable customer outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience, including hands-on development with NodeJS and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years of experience in the design and architecture of new and existing systems (design patterns, reliability, and scaling).
  • Demonstrable experience leading technical projects: scoping, sequencing milestones, driving execution, and shipping to production.
  • Experience operating production services: debugging, incident response, and improving observability and on-call readiness.
  • Experience designing secure systems and applying secure SDLC practices aligned with SOC 2 Type II or similar compliance frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience across the full software development lifecycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build pipelines, automated testing, and operations.
  • Experience building complex, distributed systems (e.g., workflow/orchestration engines, event-driven systems, rules/policy evaluation, integrations).

  • Experience building integrations with enterprise systems (APIs, authn/authz patterns, webhooks, data sync, and auditability).

Remote (United States).

Base salary range: $150,000–$200,000 USD, plus equity. Final offer within the range depends on experience, level, and skills. This is a remote, US-based role; compensation is not set to Bay Area / NYC bands.

  • Administer and optimize databases, including relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB)

  • Monitor and optimize data platform performance, including latency, throughput, and resource utilization

Proficient in infrastructure, security, software development, database management systems, and systems integration. Develops using agile processes and common technology stacks.

jobs.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Job Title: Senior Service Program Director

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

The Senior Service Program Director is responsible for leading the overall success of strategic customer service partnerships by driving customer satisfaction, operational performance, program governance, retention, profitable growth, and long-term partnership value. This role serves as the senior customer-facing leader and strategic point of accountability for assigned enterprise healthcare systems, ensuring GE HealthCare delivers on service commitments, operational expectations, contractual obligations, and business outcomes.

The Senior Director provides business and program management leadership across the GE HealthCare–customer service partnership, developing strategies that support customer satisfaction, retention, growth, and operational excellence. This role works in close alignment with Executive Client Director, regional service teams, functional centers of excellence, commercial partners, finance, field service, supply chain, engineering, and executive leadership to ensure a coordinated, enterprise-wide approach to customer success.

This role also includes direct people leadership responsibility for 5+ direct reports, which may include Service Program Managers, Enterprise Program Managers, Asset Management Leaders, and other customer operations or program leadership roles. The Senior Director is accountable for building team capability, setting clear expectations, coaching performance, aligning work to business priorities, and ensuring consistent execution across the customer operations organization.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Customer Partnership & Executive Engagement

  • Serve as the senior strategic customer interface for assigned enterprise service partnerships.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with executive, operational, clinical, technical, and administrative customer stakeholders.
  • Establish trusted partnership with customer leadership to understand priorities, business objectives, pain points, and opportunities for value creation.
  • Lead executive governance discussions, strategic business reviews, and senior-level customer engagement routines.
  • Represent GE HealthCare in strategic, operational, contractual, and business discussions with the customer.
  • Protect and strengthen the customer relationship by ensuring issues are addressed proactively, transparently, and with clear ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnership value, strengthen retention, and protect against competitive threats.

2. Service Partnership Governance & Operational Leadership

  • Lead the overall governance model for assigned customer partnerships, ensuring clear operating mechanisms, escalation paths, communication routines, and decision-making processes are in place.
  • Implement robust reporting and review processes to track service performance, program progress, KPIs, customer commitments, operational risks, financial performance, and project status.
  • Ensure internal and external governance routines are effective, action-oriented, and aligned to customer and GE HealthCare objectives.
  • Facilitate alignment across account teams, regional service teams, field service, functional centers of excellence, and commercial partners.
  • Drive operational discipline across customer programs to ensure commitments, deliverables, and improvement actions are completed on time.
  • Lead regular program, technical, operational, and executive reviews with customers and internal leadership.

3. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly lead, coach, and develop a team of 5+ direct reports, including roles such as SPM, EPM, AML, and other customer operations/program leadership positions.
  • Set clear performance expectations, priorities, operating rhythms, and accountability standards for direct reports.
  • Coach team members on customer engagement, communication, escalation management, project execution, executive readiness, and operational ownership.
  • Build leadership capability across the team by developing talent, identifying skill gaps, supporting career growth, and creating development plans.
  • Establish consistent team standards for customer communication, business reviews, contract governance, escalation management, reporting, and follow-through.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, team operating reviews, performance check-ins, and development conversations.
  • Create a high-accountability, customer-centric culture focused on ownership, proactive communication, operational excellence, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure team members are aligned to customer priorities, GE HealthCare strategy, regional objectives, and service delivery commitments.

4. Customer Satisfaction, Retention & Growth

  • Own strategic programs that improve customer satisfaction, customer experience, and long-term retention.
  • Develop and execute customer success strategies that support service partnership health, contract renewal, expansion opportunities, and customer loyalty.
  • Partner with commercial and account teams to identify growth opportunities, renewal risks, service expansion needs, and broader GE HealthCare portfolio solutions.
  • Use customer feedback, performance data, and Voice of Customer insights to drive continuous improvement and strengthen partnership value.
  • Proactively identify risks to customer satisfaction and lead mitigation plans across internal teams.
  • Ensure customer priorities are translated into measurable actions, owners, timelines, and outcomes.

5. Contract, Financial & Business Performance Leadership

  • Provide leadership oversight for service partnership performance against contractual, operational, financial, and customer commitments.
  • Ensure appropriate contract documents, acceptance certificates, variation agreements, governance documentation, and customer-facing commitments are completed accurately and on time.
  • Partner with finance, commercial, service, and operations teams to monitor profitability, cost performance, operational risk, billing issues, and contract health.
  • Establish operational mechanisms to manage long-term program liabilities, customer obligations, quality expectations, safety requirements, and profitability objectives.
  • Support contract renewal strategies, expansion discussions, financial reviews, and customer business planning.
  • Drive accountability for accurate reporting, issue resolution, milestone tracking, and financial performance visibility.

6. Escalation Leadership & Enterprise Problem Resolution

  • Lead senior-level customer escalations and high-visibility service events requiring cross-functional alignment and executive awareness.
  • Act as the customer advocate within GE HealthCare while balancing customer needs, contractual obligations, operational realities, and business objectives.
  • Ensure escalations have clear ownership, timeline, communication plan, root-cause review, and corrective action path.
  • Coordinate across field service, supply chain, engineering, technical support, commercial, finance, and leadership teams to resolve complex issues.
  • Communicate transparently with customer and internal stakeholders during critical events.
  • Drive sustainable corrective actions to prevent repeat issues and improve service delivery.

7. Program Management, Project Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Lead enterprise-level programs, initiatives, and workstreams that support service partnership success.
  • Track programmatic and project progress against agreed plans, customer commitments, KPI targets, operational risks, cost expectations, and performance objectives.
  • Drive operational excellence initiatives that improve efficiency, customer experience, profitability, service delivery, and internal accountability.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to develop and communicate best practices across the enterprise.
  • Ensure program updates, dashboards, action logs, and leadership reports are accurate, timely, and outcome-focused.
  • Hold internal stakeholders accountable for execution of customer commitments and continuous improvement actions.

8. Cross-Functional Leadership & Enterprise Alignment

  • Lead through influence across a matrixed organization to align resources, remove barriers, and ensure customer commitments are achieved.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives, Service Leadership, Field Service, Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Engineering, Legal, Quality, and Centers of Excellence.
  • Ensure communication is clear and consistent across customer teams, internal leadership, direct reports, and support functions.
  • Represent customer needs and operational risks in internal leadership discussions.
  • Build alignment across GE HealthCare teams to deliver a unified customer experience.

9. Compliance, Quality & Risk Management

  • Ensure customer programs operate in alignment with GE HealthCare policies, quality requirements, contractual obligations, governance expectations, and safety standards.
  • Monitor operational risk, service performance risk, project risk, customer satisfaction risk, and financial risk across assigned partnerships.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, reporting, contract records, customer commitments, and governance materials are maintained.
  • Support audits, operational reviews, compliance activities, and customer governance requirements as needed.

Desired Attributes

The successful Senior Director demonstrates:

  • Executive presence and strong customer-facing leadership
  • Ability to build trust with senior customer stakeholders
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, and team development capability
  • High accountability and ownership mindset
  • Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment
  • Strong business acumen, including financial, operational, and contractual awareness
  • Customer-centric decision making
  • Strategic thinking balanced with operational execution
  • Strong communication and executive-level presentation skills
  • Ability to synthesize complex issues and communicate clear actions
  • Strong program management and governance discipline
  • Ability to drive retention, growth, and partnership value
  • Confidence leading escalations and complex problem resolution
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Ability to build scalable processes and consistent operating rhythms

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, Operations, or related field.
  • 8+ years of healthcare project/program management, service leadership, customer operations, or related experience.
  • 5+ years of direct team leadership experience.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software from design through production.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Deep understanding of hooks, component composition, Context, Suspense, lazy loading, concurrent rendering, and rendering lifecycle.

Strong understanding of React performance optimisation, memoisation, and rendering behaviour.

Experience designing reusable component libraries and scalable frontend architectures.

Ability to reason about state ownership, derived state, effects, and component responsibilities.

TypeScript

Strong experience writing production applications in TypeScript.

Comfortable working with strict typing, discriminated unions, utility types, generics, and advanced type inference.

Experience using TypeScript to improve application design and developer experience.

TanStack Router

Experience building applications using nested routing, route loaders, search parameter validation, route

guards, and code splitting.

TanStack Query

TanStack Form

You understand when to introduce abstractions and when to keep solutions simple.

You understand the difference between local UI state, URL state, and server state, and choose the appropriate tool for each.

You leverage TypeScript as a design tool rather than simply a type checker.

You proactively identify opportunities to improve performance, accessibility, and developer experience.

You take ownership of the systems you build and consider long-term maintainability alongside feature delivery.

The ideal candidate is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with employees and managers across different countries and time zones. Strong communication skills, discretion in handling confidential information, and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential.

Key Responsibilities:

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Support the Head of People & Culture with the day-to-day operation of the global People & Culture function.
  • Coordinate and administer employee lifecycle processes from hire through departure.
  • Prepare and administer offer letters, employment documentation, promotion letters, salary change letters, employment change documentation, probation-related documentation, and other routine employee correspondence.
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding activities and ensure required actions are completed by the appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate and complete employee records and documentation.
  • Track employee changes and ensure they are reflected accurately across applicable HR and payroll systems.
  • Maintain HR trackers, calendars, checklists, and other operational tools to ensure important activities and deadlines are not missed.
  • Support annual and recurring People & Culture processes as required.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment when handling sensitive employee information.

HRIS & BambooHR Administration

Serve as a primary administrator and operational owner of BambooHR, including:

  • Maintaining accurate employee records and employment information.
  • Processing new hires, employee changes, promotions, compensation changes, departures, and other employee lifecycle transactions.
  • Administering time-off policies and employee leave records.
  • Maintaining organizational and reporting information.
  • Supporting BambooHR workflows, approvals, documentation, and employee records.
  • Supporting the BambooHR Applicant Tracking System and recruitment workflows.
  • Running and maintaining HR reports.
  • Conducting regular data reviews to identify missing, inaccurate, or outdated information.
  • Troubleshooting routine employee and manager questions regarding BambooHR.
  • Identifying opportunities to better utilize BambooHR functionality and automate manual HR processes.
  • Creating and documenting consistent procedures for HRIS administration.

Prior BambooHR experience is strongly preferred; however, candidates with significant experience administering another HRIS and the ability to learn new systems quickly will also be considered.

Payroll Administration

Support and coordinate payroll administration for employees in the United States and United Kingdom, including:

  • Preparing and reviewing payroll-related employee changes.
  • Coordinating new hires and terminations with payroll.
  • Processing salary increases, promotions, bonuses, and other compensation changes.
  • Ensuring leave and other employee status changes are appropriately reflected in payroll.
  • Reviewing payroll information for accuracy before processing.
  • Maintaining payroll change documentation and supporting appropriate internal approvals.
  • Identifying discrepancies and coordinating corrections.
  • Maintaining accurate records of payroll changes and effective dates.
  • Partnering with Finance, payroll providers, and the Head of People & Culture as needed.
  • Experience supporting U.S. and/or UK payroll administration is strongly preferred.

Leave of Absence & Time-Off Administration

  • Coordinate the administrative aspects of employee leaves of absence.
  • Maintain accurate leave documentation, dates, correspondence, and HRIS records.
  • Support maternity, parental, medical, and other applicable leave processes.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation and approvals are received and maintained.
  • Track important leave dates and proactively follow up on required actions.
  • Administer company time-off policies within BambooHR.
  • Respond to routine employee questions regarding time-off processes and policies.
  • Escalate complex leave, legal, or employee-relations matters to the Head of People & Culture.
  • Ensure leave and time-off administration is consistent with internal policies and established procedures.

Recruitment & Hiring Coordination

  • Provide operational support throughout the recruitment and hiring process.
  • Schedule interviews across multiple time zones and coordinate candidate availability with hiring teams.
  • Maintain candidate records and recruitment activity within the ATS.
  • Support candidate communications throughout the interview process.
  • Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with interviewers as needed.
  • Prepare offer documentation and support the transition from candidate to new employee.
  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding requirements.
  • Maintain recruitment trackers and ensure candidates continue moving through the process in a timely manner.
  • Support the Head of People & Culture and hiring managers with other recruitment activities as required.

Training & Compliance Administration

  • Administer the company's employee training platform.
  • Assign required training to employees.
  • Track completion of mandatory and role-specific training.
  • Follow up with employees and managers regarding outstanding training.
  • Maintain accurate training records and completion reports.
  • Support the rollout of new policies, procedures, and required acknowledgements.
  • Maintain records of employee policy acknowledgements and other required documentation.
  • Assist with ongoing compliance tracking and reporting.

People & Culture Inbox & Employee Support

  • Take primary operational responsibility for monitoring the People & Culture inbox.
  • Ensure employee and manager questions are acknowledged and addressed in a timely manner.

  • Route requests to the appropriate People & Culture team member or internal stakeholder when necessary.

  • Identify urgent, sensitive, or complex employee matters and promptly escalate them to the Head of People & Culture.

Policies, Procedures & HR Compliance

Process Improvement & Organization

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager / Business Analyst - Consultant
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Liberum exists to deliver in the environments where most firms struggle.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Liberum exists to deliver in the environments where most firms struggle. Our clients are public sector agencies navigating enterprise-scale transformations in politically complex, high-stakes environments where the margin for error is thin, and the consequences of failure are public. We believe clients deserve real ownership, not warm bodies and hope.

We’re a team first. Not a loose collection of consultants sharing a logo, but a genuine team that pushes each other’s thinking, pressure-tests each other’s work, and shows up when engagements get hard. The people we hire make the team better, not just their own deliverables.

We’re also building an AI-forward consulting practice. Our consultants don’t treat AI as a novelty or a side experiment. They integrate it into how they plan, analyze, build, and deliver. AI is a force multiplier at Liberum, and every practitioner is expected to wield it with the same rigor they bring to their core discipline.

If you’re looking for a comfortable seat and a steady paycheck, this isn’t the role. If you want to be part of a team that does hard things extraordinarily well, with every available advantage. Keep reading.

The Role

This is a dual-capacity position: you will provide both project management leadership and business analysis expertise to support large-scale Washington State ERP initiatives. This is not two half-roles stitched together. It’s a senior-level position for a seasoned professional who can seamlessly shift between driving project delivery and performing rigorous business analysis within the same engagement, often in the same week.

The right candidate brings deep public sector experience, hands-on ERP implementation knowledge, and direct Workday expertise. On the PM side, you bring genuine planning rigor: resource-loaded schedules, dependency mapping, and the discipline to keep plans current and actionable, not decorative artifacts that gather dust. On the BA side, you go beyond documenting requirements to identify gaps and risks the client hasn’t recognized, and you translate complex operational realities into clear, actionable specifications that technical teams can actually build from.

You are an AI-enabled consultant. You use AI tools daily to work faster and smarter, whether that’s rapidly synthesizing meeting notes and interview data into requirements artifacts, using AI to identify patterns and risks in project data, building executive-ready deliverables in a fraction of the time, or automating the repetitive analytical work that bogs down traditional consultants. You don’t see AI as separate from your PM and BA practice. It’s woven into how you operate, and it’s one of the reasons you deliver at a level your peers can’t match.

You operate with an ownership mentality. You drive work forward, take responsibility for outcomes beyond your immediate scope, and build clarity when things are ambiguous or off-track, without waiting for direction. You’re comfortable delivering hard truths to executive stakeholders with data and a solution already in hand. You understand that making your value visible to the client is as important as delivering it.

As a Liberum team member, you collaborate fully, communicate proactively, and never operate in isolation. You see the big picture while owning your piece of it. You make the people and engagements around you better.

What You’ll Do

Project Management & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex, multi-workstream engagements including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and issue management
  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed MS Project plans with dependencies, resource loading, and elaborated tasks; apply hybrid Agile/Waterfall approaches appropriate to the engagement context
  • Drive clarity and alignment when project conditions are ambiguous, off-track, or politically complex, including developing recovery plans and realignment strategies when things go sideways
  • Facilitate project status reporting, executive briefings, and governance checkpoints
  • Deliver status updates and executive reporting in visually compelling formats that tell the right story for the right audience, not just data dumps
  • Identify and proactively manage project risks and dependencies across interconnected workstreams

Business Analysis & Requirements

  • Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements through structured interviews, workshops, and process observation
  • Develop and maintain business process flow diagrams, gap analyses, use cases, and other analytical artifacts that drive clarity, not just check boxes
  • Assess current state and future state business processes to identify impacts, risks, and opportunities associated with system and operational changes
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable specifications for technical teams and system integrators, specifications they can actually build from without three rounds of clarification
  • Support configuration, testing, and validation activities related to ERP/Workday implementation workstreams, including UAT planning and execution

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Use AI tools to rapidly synthesize meeting notes, interview transcripts, and workshop outputs into structured requirements documents, gap analyses, and decision frameworks, compressing days of manual synthesis into hours
  • Use AI for project data analysis: identifying risk patterns across workstreams, surfacing schedule dependencies, forecasting resource conflicts, and generating early-warning indicators that inform proactive decision-making
  • Use AI to accelerate the creation of executive-ready deliverables: status reports, briefing decks, business cases, and analytical artifacts, at a quality and speed that traditional approaches can’t match
  • Use AI as an analytical partner to pressure-test requirements, validate business process logic, identify specification gaps, and stress-test assumptions before they reach technical teams
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools and techniques that improve PM and BA delivery, and share innovations with the Liberum team to raise the collective capability

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Manage relationships with executive sponsors, steering committees, and cross-functional stakeholders across state agency environments
  • Engage and build foundational relationships with customers, project sponsors, vendors, and external stakeholders
  • Coordinate across vendor, state agency, and internal Liberum team members to ensure integrated delivery
  • Proactively communicate project progress, risks, and value delivered to client stakeholders, ensuring visibility into team contributions throughout the engagement

Team & Client Development

  • Coach and mentor client-side staff to build internal PM and BA capability where applicable
  • Collaborate with OCM, training, and communications teams to ensure PM and BA outputs support adoption and readiness activities
  • Identify opportunities to create additional client value throughout the engagement lifecycle, not just fulfill the SOW, but actively look for ways to make the client better

Requirements

What We Require

These aren’t suggestions. If you can’t back each of these up with specific examples, this isn’t the right fit yet.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of combined experience in project management and business analysis roles, with demonstrated senior-level performance in both functions, not just titles but outcomes you can walk us through
  • Direct experience supporting or delivering at least one major ERP implementation (Workday, SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, or equivalent)
  • Workday experience: functional knowledge of one or more Workday modules (HCM, Finance, Payroll, etc.) preferred, with hands-on configuration or testing experience ideal
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects in highly regulated or politically sensitive environments, where the org chart doesn’t tell you who actually makes decisions
  • Experience facilitating executive-level stakeholder engagement, including steering committees and sponsor briefings
  • Proficiency in developing business process documentation, requirements artifacts, and gap analysis deliverables that drive action, not shelf-ware
  • Experience conducting business interviews and leading client workshops at both operational and leadership levels
  • Active, daily use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) integrated into your PM and BA workflow, not occasional experimentation, but a fundamental part of how you work. You should be able to demonstrate specific examples of how AI has changed your delivery speed, quality, or analytical depth.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI for document synthesis, requirements analysis, data pattern recognition, risk identification, and deliverable creation in a professional consulting context
  • Comfort prompting and directing AI tools effectively. You understand how to get high-quality, contextually appropriate outputs and know the limitations of AI-generated content
  • Intellectual curiosity and initiative around emerging AI capabilities. Proactively experiment with new tools and bring innovations to your team, not wait for someone to assign them
  • Strong writing skills: the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise deliverables for both technical audiences and executive stakeholders
  • Hybrid methodology fluency: ability to blend Agile and Waterfall approaches pragmatically based on what the project and client actually need
  • Proficiency in MS Project or equivalent scheduling tools, including dependency mapping and resource-loaded plans
  • Professional courage to deliver difficult findings and recommendations with data, grace, and actionable solutions, not just flag problems, but bring answers
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively within a remote or hybrid team environment
  • Exceptional client relationship management skills
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management credential preferred
  • PMI-PBA or CBAP certification a plus

What Sets You Apart

Not required, but these will move you to the front of the line.

  • Master’s Degree in Business, Public Administration, Information Systems, or related field
  • Consulting experience with public sector clients

Senior AI Data Engineer

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior AI Data Engineer to design and operate the data foundation that our AI systems depend on. This role owns the movement, modeling, and quality of data from source systems through the warehouse and into the retrieval and feature layers that power LLM pipelines, agentic workflows, and analytical products.

The ideal candidate is a rigorous software engineer first and a data specialist second: someone who models a warehouse deliberately, writes production Python that other engineers can extend, and treats pipelines as versioned, tested, observable software rather than scripts.

This role partners closely with the AI/ML Data Scientist, who owns model behavior and retrieval strategy.

The boundary: you own the pipeline, the schema, and the guarantees; they own the algorithm, the prompt, and the evaluation.

Required Qualifications

5-10+ years in software engineering or data engineering, with substantial time in production data platform work.

Data warehousing: demonstrable command of Kimball dimensional modeling - not just familiarity with the vocabulary, but the judgment to choose a grain, resolve a many-to-many relationship, and know when to denormalize. Working knowledge of alternative approaches (Data Vault, One Big Table, Inman) and the tradeoffs against Kimball.

SQL: expert-level - window functions, CTEs, query plan reading, and performance tuning on a columnar warehouse.

Python: expert-level, production-grade - typing, packaging, dependency management, testing.

Design: SOLID and domain-driven design applied in real systems, with examples you can walk through.

Orchestration: Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or equivalent, in production.

Cloud: expert-level on AWS, Azure, or GCP - storage, compute, IAM, networking, and cost management.

Platform: containerization, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), and CI/CD.

Experience with lakehouse table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi) and their maintenance characteristics: compaction, snapshot expiry, schema and partition evolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building the data layer beneath production RAG systems, including hybrid search infrastructure and index freshness guarantees.

Streaming systems: Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming.

dbt or an equivalent transformation and testing framework.

Data quality tooling (Great Expectations, Soda, or similar) and catalog/lineage platforms.

Familiarity with the model-facing side of the stack - MLflow, Weights & Biases, feature stores - sufficient to collaborate credibly with data scientists.

Experience with AI security, governance, and compliance frameworks.

Open-source contributions to data or AI infrastructure projects.

This full-time remote role combines freight management, Amazon FBA coordination, inventory forecasting, and reverse logistics to ensure smooth operations across all sales channels. About the company:

The company is a premium pet brand known for its high-quality, durable bulky pet products and accessories. Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brands products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for an Inventory & Logistics Specialist to help scale that mission by ensuring seamless product flow from factory to customer.

Key Responsibilities:

Freight & Supply Chain Management

  • Manage end-to-end order placement with factories and track order progress through to completion.
  • Request, negotiate, and select the best quotes from freight forwarders, determining the optimal type of sea freight for each specific situation.
  • Design ideal loading configurations for shipping containers based on product dimensions to maximize space and reduce shipping costs.
  • Oversee the loading process through active communication with factories and freight partners.
  • Track all global shipments, proactively flagging and mitigating any potential delays.

Amazon FBA & E-commerce Operations

  • Create and manage Amazon Shipments, utilizing software solutions (e.g., 9Yards and similar simulation tools) to run multiple simulations and target the most cost-effective Amazon warehouses.

  • Perform thorough reconciliation for all inbound shipments to ensure accurate stock levels and file claims for missing units when necessary.
  • Coordinate Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) orders for Last Mile transport from our 3PL to customers for non-Amazon (DTC/B2B) orders.

Inventory Forecasting & Management

  • Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
  • Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.

Reverse Logistics & Returns Management

  • Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
  • Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
  • Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Scale of Operations:

  • Container Shipments: ~8 per month.
  • LTL Orders (Last Mile): ~10 per week.
  • Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Software & Workflow Proficiency:

  • Amazon FBA & E-commerce Systems: Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central, FBA placement optimization, inbound reconciliation, and removal/disposal orders.
  • Forecasting & Inventory Management: Hands-on experience with IMS tools (SoStocked, RestockPro, Cin7, Skubana), advanced Excel or Google Sheets for SKU-level forecasting and run-rate models.
  • Logistics, Freight & 3PL Integration: Familiarity with container load planning software (EasyCargo, CubeMaster), freight platforms (Flexport, Freightos), warehouse management systems (ShipStation, ShipHero), and reverse logistics workflows.

Core Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
  • Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
  • Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Why Join Us:

  • Play a critical role in ensuring smooth operations for a high-ticket pet brand on Amazon.
  • Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.
  • Collaborate with a creative, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation in the pet space.
  • Make a tangible impact on a brand that values quality, customer experience, and operational excellence.

  2. Partner Enablement

  • Maintain and refresh product and security content as services and integrations evolve.

Your First 90 Days

  • Start Delivering
  • Produce priority channel enablement assets.

We are a small senior marketing team working in a fast-paced environment with high visibility and high expectations. You will work closely with Channel Directors, sales leadership, and technology partners, and your work will have direct impact across the business.

This role suits someone who:

  • takes ownership and executes well within an existing strategy,
  • stays calm and organised under pressure,
  • is proactive and self-directed,
  • communicates confidently and works well with strong personalities,
  • is resilient and adaptable in a fast-moving environment.

This role sits at the intersection of field, channel, and content. You’ll work closely with the Senior Growth Marketing Lead to take our overarching strategy, positioning, and content and turn it into partner-ready programs and assets that are clear, practical, and easy to apply.

You’ll help partners recognize opportunities, position us confidently, and know when to bring us into a deal.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What Clinical Trial Liaison does at Worldwide

The Clinical Trial Liaison will serve in part as a Strategic Site Relationship Manager, establishing and maintaining strong relationships with clinical investigators and site staff within their therapeutic areas of expertise and providing insights to internal teams and sponsors, with an overall focus on successful trial execution.

The Clinical Trial Liaison will also assist with the overall remit for Scientific Solutions, ensuring quality endpoints are achieved through optimal site selection and assisting sites with understanding of protocols and enrolment of proper trial participants.

What you will do

Tasks may include but are not limited to:
  • Establish and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, sites, and their staff.
  • Conduct targeted conversations with the investigators and site staff regarding operational challenges, including but not limited to those related to patient recruitment and retention.
  • Have clinical and scientific discussions with investigators to ensure overall quality of study endpoints, including but not limited to understanding of clinical protocols, study feasibility, and enrolment and retention of appropriate trial participants.
  • Convey KOL and site staff feedback and insight to internal and external teams.
  • Support and guide project teams with site identification and selection based on knowledge of site capabilities and anticipated protocol challenges.
  • Support project teams regarding site performance issues. Work closely with internal study teams and sites to foresee and proactively manage study site issues as they occur to maintain study timelines and quality. Initiate, recommend, and communicate corrective actions as needed.
  • Serve as an alternative contact point for site issue escalations outside the scope of the CRA for internal and external team members as well as to advance Worldwide’s visibility as industry leading in their given therapeutic area.
  • Assist in the identification of possible new sites and upskilling for trial participation as needed.
  • Support business development activities through engagement with existing and prospective clients. Provide scientific and operational input on proposals in development; attend and present at bid defense meetings.
  • Provide scientific and operational input into protocol development and review, as applicable.
  • Plan and conduct internal training to facilitate protocol understanding in assigned therapeutic area.
  • Represent Worldwide Clinical Trials at relevant industry conferences and scientific meetings.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What you will bring to the role

Excellent networking skills to represent Worldwide with key local stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to interact with physicians and all levels of internal and external management.
  • Excellent negotiation, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated with proactive issue monitoring and management, including risk assessment and contingency planning.
  • Possess a combination of critical thinking and operational expertise and efficiency.

Your experience

  • A doctoral degree is required, or alternatively, a candidate may possess a bachelor's/master's degree accompanied by experience as an advanced practice provider, such as a Physician’s Assistant, Nurse Practitioner, or another licensed healthcare provider.
  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in clinical research in academia, Pharma, Biotech, or CRO, including background in operational aspects of clinical research.
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in the therapeutic area/indication assigned.
  • Demonstrated experience of working directly with clinical sites and investigators.
  • Demonstrated customer service and relationship-building skills with clinical sites (on-site and remote).

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote design accelerator apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our design apprentices work through the end-to-end digital design and research process for a startup idea of their choice.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and build an idea they are passionate about!

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to business owners, startup founders, new grads and career changers looking for creative outlets! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in entrepreneurship, building a digital app, AI app, or digital startup idea
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX and business tips and challenges via email and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

Location: Canada (Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers

Role Summary

Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O'Brien, is seeking a highly experienced Power Studies Engineer to join our team and support the analysis and design of complex electrical power systems for hyperscale and AI data centers across Canada and North America. This is a remote role within an innovative, international engineering firm recognized for its cutting-edge work in mission-critical infrastructure.

As a Power Studies Engineer, you will play a key role in evaluating electrical system performance, reliability, and resiliency through advanced power system studies and modeling. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, utility providers, and project stakeholders to develop solutions for high-density AI and mission-critical facilities where system reliability and uptime are paramount.

This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects for global clients in the hyperscale data center market while advancing your career in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

What We Offer

  • Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company
  • Opportunity to work on unique, cutting-edge hyperscale and AI data center projects
  • Comprehensive training and professional development opportunities
  • Supportive leadership and a collaborative team environment
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities
  • Competitive salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including extended health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, retirement savings program (where applicable), and other employee benefits
  • Stock ownership / synthetic equity opportunities
  • Flexible remote work environment

What You Will Do

  • Perform power system studies including load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, grounding, power quality, harmonic analysis, transient analysis, and reliability studies.
  • Develop and maintain electrical system models using PSCAD, ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, or similar software platforms.
  • Perform electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies to evaluate system behavior during switching events, faults, utility disturbances, and large load changes.
  • Analyze the impact of high-density AI loads and other mission-critical electrical loads on utility systems, emergency generation, UPS systems, and facility electrical infrastructure.
  • Support utility interconnection studies and coordinate with utility providers regarding service requirements and system performance.
  • Evaluate system reliability, redundancy strategies, contingency scenarios, and overall power system resiliency.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, study documentation, and engineering recommendations.
  • Collaborate with electrical design teams on medium-voltage systems, substations, standby generation, UPS systems, mechanical system electrical load characteristics, and utility service infrastructure.
  • Participate in design coordination meetings with clients, consultants, utility providers, and project stakeholders.
  • Support commissioning activities and provide technical expertise during project execution.
  • Review engineering deliverables for technical accuracy, quality, and compliance with applicable industry standards.

What We Expect

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university.
  • 8–15 years of experience in power systems engineering, utility engineering, substations, transmission and distribution, industrial facilities, renewable energy, mining, or mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience performing power system studies, including transient, harmonic, grounding, load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, and arc flash analysis.
  • Proficiency with PSCAD is required.
  • Experience with ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, CYME, or similar power system analysis software.
  • Strong understanding of electrical power systems, utility infrastructure, substations, protective relaying, and system reliability.
  • Experience with utility interconnections and medium-voltage power systems.
  • Experience performing underground duct bank ampacity and heat studies (Neher-McGrath methodology) is considered an asset.
  • Registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Canada, or eligibility to obtain registration, is considered an asset.
  • Strong knowledge of the Canadian Electrical Code (CEC), CSA standards, IEEE standards, utility requirements, and applicable provincial electrical regulations. Familiarity with U.S. codes and standards (NEC, NFPA, IEEE) is considered an asset.
  • Excellent technical writing, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively present technical findings and recommendations to clients.
  • Experience supporting data center, utility, industrial, or other large-scale infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Canada.

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge hyperscale and AI data center projects in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.
